Unfortunately, a lot of students in our class did not attend the Zoom lectures that she did, but she was very engaging during them and more than happy to answer questions. Overall, would absolutely recommend taking any class that she is teaching!

if you can, you must take Stepp!! She's literally the best professor I've ever had in college. Her lectures are actually amusing and she welcomes all questions without any judgement. She is available during office hours and is SO helpful outside of class! She cares for you and your understanding of math!

Elizabeth Stepp is one of the best math professors I've ever had. Although a lot of the course comes down to using formulas correctly and requires a more in-depth knowledge of statistics and data analysis to fully grasp, Professor Stepp does an amazing job teaching it. She genuinely cares about her students and makes herself available out of class.

I had Professor Stepp over 10 years ago, she has a genuine interest in the student's learning and success. She went above and beyond by offering help to students help over instant messenger(again this was over 10 years ago and AIM was a thing). Definitely would recommend her, to be fair I don't remember how difficult the class was.

Professor Stepp is super nice and caring, she's always available outside class and responds to emails fairly quickly. The examples she does in class are almost always on the exams. She really wants you to understand and do well. Definitely recommend taking her class.

Professor Step is the most caring professor I've ever had. She is always accessible during office hours and after class and does her best to help her students. She also asks for students' opinions on how they want to spend class time before exams, and adjusts to their needs.

Professor Stepp is a stellar professor. She allows the students to take full independence--attendance, homework, lectures is all in your hands. Nonetheless, she offers in-depth lectures, eagerly answers questions, and consistently seeks to improve as a teacher and mentor. The tests are easy (definitely easier than any practice tests or homework).
Professor Stepp is the best math teach I have ever had. You are extremely luck if you get her. She is a hilarious person and an even better professor.
Caring, kind, and always tries to make the class more entertaining. Would definitely recommend to everyone

Steppy (as she playfully known by her students ) is one of the most caring and knowledgeable teachers at NYU--a rare mix in core class professors. She is very reachable outside of class and will always respond to her students in kind. I almost wish I studied math so I could have more classes with her.
She's extremely fast paced and has a lot of homework. I could not understand the class at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Stepp is by far the best professor I've had at NYU (rising senior, took her class when I was a freshman). She went out of her way to learn every one's name  and sat down before and after class to help people with their homework. She went above and beyond during office hours, and gave really clear lectures. I'm not a math major, but she is amazing.

Stepp is an amazing professor. I had her for two semesters and I can easily say that she is extremely fair, helpful, and passionate about her job. Math is not my best subject but she made it pretty interesting in her quantitative reasoning class. I would definitely recommend her to anyone.
Her Elementary Statistics is really easy and the TAs are extremely helpful. Not necessarily have to go to class but don't miss the quizzes.
I had Professor Stepp in Hunter College and she is an amazing math professor. She is very genuine and intelligent in her field. I would really like her again and again if I could!!

Consulted outside learning sources because her lectures are too fastpaced. I have taken an intensive stats in high school but sitting in this class is torturous. Her office hours are very limited so don't rely on her to help you when you need, you'd be lucky if you had a good TA. Most never attended lectures all semester. Self taught instead.

I don't see what the fuss is about. She is ok as a person, quite funny, playful and nice. But as a lecturer, she isn't the best. She never explains things really well. I had taken statistics before and I got through the first part of the semester with my previous knowledge. All she did was make things more complicated in my head.

She seems strict at first, but she really isn't. She's very nice and is very clear when teaching the class. Sometimes she goes off on a tangent and wastes a little time, but otherwise she has very high energy and is extremely friendly. She will help clarify any concept when you are confused. A lot of homework that is very repetitive.

Amazing math professor that is always willing to go above and beyond especially in terms of helping. She does assign a lot of home work but it is to keep the material fresh in the students minds. THE BEST MATH PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD

Elizabeth keeps her students laughing from the beginning to the end of class! She is such a character and a great character. She offers extra help if needed and the class is not too bad even for those not skilled in math. Take her class for CORE!!

Absolutely love Stepp. I wouldn't say she was an easy teacher but she is more than fair. Gives clear guidelines about what homework and test are going to be like, and often is more lenient than she initially states. Stepp is super nice and has a great energy. Easy and interesting to talk to outside of class! Would take classes with her again.

I hate hate hate math, and was required to take at least one math course. I would highly recommend Prof. Stepp, especially her Great Ideas in Mathematics course. She made math actually interesting and accessible.
Math has always been my worst subject but Professor Stepp was very thorough and always answered questions in lecture. She's also always available during her office hours or if you send her an email.
She's just the best. I hate math and she's made it at least tolerable for me.

Stepp is the best professor I've had at NYU. She is a clear communicator and fair grader. Her assignments and quizzes outside of class take time, but help you learn the material and improve your grade. I  recommend going to her office hours because she is very helpful and will get to know you on a personal level. She really cares about her students

I had this professor for Great Ideas in Mathematics. She was very friendly and approachable. I would recommend you to go to her lectures (though they are not mandatory because she does not check attendance). Her quizzes are super easy and the homework only takes 15-30 minutes to complete. She's an easy grader as well. Take her for an easy A.

I took Quantitative Reasoning with Stepp. She could not have cared less about the class or her students. She obviously has an interest in her higher level math classes, and left us out to dry. She doesn't talk to her TAs and the class was a mess. Don't recommend unless you take high level math

Great teacher that cares about her students. Her Calc III midterms are 6 hours long though (must take five parts - worth 50% of midterm grade-  outside of class but you can retake those parts as many times as you want to get a better grade). Her class is a lot of work but helps you stay on track and prevents cramming at the last minute.
One of the best professors. Really likes teaching, always makes time outside of class to help students. Very fair. Super nice and helpful
Very helpful and super awesome. Glad I got her.

Stepp is an excellent and articulate teacher who keeps you engaged. The beginning of Calc II was all a review from Calc AB but near the end, it was challenging. The WA is easy but the written homework is difficult and time consuming. However the class can only be curved to the students benefit.

PROS: She curves final grade depending on class performance; she answers emails quickly; she is willing to help you during office hours; she drops lower scores; she is funny and easy going. CONS: Written Homework is way too hard; midterms are tricky sometimes; she might go somewhat fast lecturing. RECOMMENDATIONS: Take her; great math instructor
good professor

Good teacher, clear on her lessons. Grading system however is flawed. Her method of homework grading is beyond appalling. Because of homework, I have a solid A on Midterms and Quizzes and still have a B average due to homework. You get marked down for such negligible reasons on homework and it's not negotiable.

the best computer science professor at nyu prof Ramos who genuinely teaches you without being patronizing I sat in front of him and witnessed his enthusiasm for teaching so take him whenever you can He is the best guy ever
Spent a lot of the class troubleshooting and the class felt disorganized and boring. Prof is nice, but all of the grading criterion is very vague. I think the subject (database) was just very boring.

Overall, it is an easy class, and you can get to learn a lot if you take the initiative. A bunch of different majors in one class, so the course and teaching is not technical; he is more on the reading and project-heavy side. He really needs to get much more organized, and the demos are not helpful. You won't have any problems with grades.

roadmap to the course is very clearly stated in his syllabus. attendence isn't "taken" but there are in-class activities that count towards your attendance, which IS part of your final grade. his grading guidelines are clear in every assignment, and he's also very easy to talk to about the grades you receive. take him if u can!! super nice guy :)
TAKE HIM!!!!
He is sooo sweet. His powerpoints are concise, gives good lectures, and super clear w how to get a good grade. Take his class!

If you are ever going to have to do anything website-related, TAKE THIS CLASS! He does an amazing job at teaching and formatting the class and it's a great intro to how to make a website from scratch. Easy A, if you do the work and the final project, is to make a website of your choice so it leaves you with something tangible.

One of the best professors at NYU. Genuinely learned so much from this class because she has informational lectures and well crafted opinions on companies. Super accessible in office hours so make the most of it.

Good Professor for strategy classes at Stern. 
Very knowledgeable

This class is very conversational lecture based. Prof Marciano usually has slides with very minimal content so the bulk of the learning is from listening to what she says and discussion. Overall, would recommend.
He's the best, best prof in nyu! If you have a chance to take his class, definitely!
The best professor at nyu

His classes are super structured and he's really approachable if you ever need to talk. The writing assignments are actually helpful and build up to make your final paper stronger. You can tell he genuinely cares about his students and always gives thoughtful, constructive feedback.

The professor is really passionate, patient, and approachable, and generally speaking, the pressure is not heavy(unless you are like me who'd always strive to perfect every essay). Not boring or theory-driven, the class is more interactive and has lots of idea exchanges. Mike really takes your own opinions seriously and gives you absolute freedom.
Best prof in NYU. Give kind scores and be friendly to students.

Professor Tyrell made WTE 2 so enjoyable. It's rare to find such a caring WTE professor who is also really knowledgable at the subject. This class was a lot easier than some of my friends' sections. Totally recommend.
I love Mike!!! Choose him!!! you will never regret it!!!
Best teacher ever, I would love to take his class again. He's caring, respects every student, and is also super knowledgeable.
GOD
chooooooose MICHAEL!!!!!!!!
It's easy to take his class even if your English is not strong, he's very nice.

Mick is a really good professor. As an international student, it's my great pleasure to have Mick teaching me for my writing class in both two semesters. He is so patient and helpful. My writing skill improved a lot during the whole academic year. Good luck freshman! I hope you can become his student.
nyu is so lucky to have this guy
The loveliest human being who extends so much grace and understanding to the entire class. Makes every class enjoyable and in some way interactive.
Mike is such a great Writing the Essay professor. He gives excellent and detailed feedback on your paper and is so accessible after class. He's caring, supportive, and will make you enjoy writing.
This is a solid 4.9/5.0 Professor. Just take it if it fits you schedule. Absolutely amazing professor--the best I have had at NYU. Seriously just take Michael's class.
It's my greatest luck to have Mike for my freshman year writing classes. Can't love him more!!!!!!!

His classes are well-organized and he is a great person to talk to. Writing exercises are designed to help you writing a great essay. He cares about everyone in his class, and he always provides insights to his students. If he sees your progression throughout the class, you'll get a good grade, though the grade for 1st essay might be discouraging.
The best professor I have ever met!!! He is caring, respectful, and passionate. He has profound knowledge and helps me grow a lot. He is fantastic. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

I barely give 5 to professors but Professor Tyrell deserves it!! He is a super interesting and respectful human being. He makes you believe that he truly cares about your works. Conversations are inspiring both in class and in individual meetings. I suffered expository writing with another prof but enjoyed this one with him! Def recommended!
Mike is totally amazing and very knowledgeable. He is passionate in his job and a very interesting person just to talk to! Highly recommended
Mike is one of the most incredible teachers I have ever had! He is extremely kind and actually cares about your growth as a writer. Love Mike so much and If I could take his class again, I would :)))

Mike is the best writing the essay professor! He really works to help you write well and get a good grade! His classes are all based around making the homework easier and gives great feedback to make your essays better. Great class environment that makes it very easy to participate!

I LOVE MIKE!!! I really wish I could take his class next semester... He is amazing, everything you could ever want in a teacher. Definitely pushes you, but so kind and understanding. He is very patient and really cares for each student. TAKE HIS CLASS!!!!!!!
He's so special not only as a professor but also as a human being. He truly cares about you and your writing. Don't even think of taking another professor for writing. He's the best.

Everyone hates on WTE but with Mike as a professor, this was my favorite class this semester. He would never lecture, but instead lead great discussions that you would actually want to be a part of. If you do all your homework (which is super easy) and actively participate in class, you have all the skills you need to write a A papers.

Mike's class is fantastic. You dont even have to address him formally just call him Mike. His lectures are awesome they just travel in so many directions its hard to be bored in that class. As long as you show up and do the exercises you should be able to write and essay that he would consider is an A.
Great professor for wte.

At first, he seems interesting (he is an actual writer after all). But once the first essay comes through, you'll understand that he has made you a better writer. He helps every student individually and opens us up to a different way to analyze writing. It's the mark of a good teacher when you feel the need to cite him at the end of your essay.

Mr. Tyrell is an incredibly wonderful and interesting teacher. He makes you think deeper and is extremely helpful. He makes class very fun and he made me actually enjoy essay writing. He is supportive and understanding. Definitely take his class! His class inspired me!!
Best Professor ever. Take him.

Tyrell is the best teacher at NYU.  He is genuinely interested in how his students are doing with such a boring class, Writing the Essay.  He doesn't try to hide the fact that no one wants to be there, but he makes it fun to be there by showing movies and reading great essays!

I always thought my writing was alright in high school, but then I took Writing the Essay. Mike won't bull**** you about your papers, he tells you when he thinks something is bad but he also is really encouraging. Makes you think of writing in new ways.
Simply the best professor I have had so far. Nice, clear, patient, smart.
MIKE TYRELL IS THE BEST! Like one of the best teachers I've had anywhere. Forget that this is a stupid, mandatory class! You will love it, and you will love him. He's cool and a genius. Nuff said.
Take him for WTE. I never really liked English before I took his class, but Mike will actually help you think outside the box and find new ways to write.
Amazing teacher, bummed I can't have him second semester. He is incredibly helpful, understanding, and sweet.
Mike is BY FAR the best Writing the Essay teacher at NYU. Once everyone learned he was the best, his class was the first to fill up for second semester. Definitely take him!

Took WTE years ago and like everyone else, dreaded the idea. Mike Tyrell made this ridiculous course into something special and taught me how to really write. WTE was actually one of the best classes I took at NYU - thanks to him! Could not recommend more.
Awesome, helpful, funny, approachable, and overall great teacher. He'll make WTE fun (GASP!) and is always able to offer useful advice on your work. Take his class!

The single most caring, helpful, hilarious teacher I've had yet. Yes, WTE is the bane of freshman year, but Mike is able to turn it into something wonderful, something that you (gasp!) will actually look forward to taking. There's a reason his class fills up immediately after registration times open.

Awesome teacher. He was born to write which is why he teaches it with such passion. Genuine and caring. An example of what a great teacher should be in ANY course. Should not leave NYU without meeting this gentleman!

It's a rarity to find a professor in any institute of learning who genuinely teaches you something. But I learned more from Mike Tyrell than I have from any other teacher I have ever had. I can't recommend him enough - he's funny, smart, knowledgable, and truly wants to make you a better writer. The ONLY teacher to take for WTE.
one of the best teachers i've ever had
Mike was an amazing teacher who always kept it real. I never thought I'd say this, but I loved Writing the Essay.
Absolutely Inspiring. Writing The Essay was my favorite class even though I didn't get a great mark on it. Mike just makes heavenly.

An overall great teacher and class! He's extremely interesting and very clear with directions! Makes a tedious class so much fun. While my other friends were complaining about WTE, I told them it was one of my favorite classes :-)

If you want to enjoy WTE and actually learn from it, TAKE MIKE! He's extremely helpful and gives you a lot to work with. Very inspiring and an overall nice guy. He loves movies, especially Godfather references. Very fair grader and lax on due dates.
Inspiring teacher
He's amazing. So sweet and helpful and he doesn't assign unnecessary work and he's always willing to talk to you about it.  Love that class.

Michael is an absolutely great professor, he makes a class that most people dread into something completely fun and organic. He will make you think about things differently and write at another level.

Michael Tyrell is great. The only thing he has a problem with is tardiness. Sometimes he wouldn't even show up in the morning! Generally an awesome teacher, though. Just take him in the afternoon and you should be fine.
Really awesome guy - WTE was my favorite class thanks to him!
Mike is great. Very clear. Very direct. Very accessible. And he has great taste in movies. As much as WTE is a pain in every freshman's side, I would gladly take a class with Mike again.
LOVE HIM
Amazing teacher! He's one of the best I've ever had, and even though I'm not in his class anymore, we're still in touch. He's eager to help with writing outside of class and outside of school.

One of the best teachers I've ever had in my life. Mike is inspiring, devilishly intelligent, funny and friendly. With him, writing essays is an art form. He always gives you specific, clear comments which improve your essay immensely. Classes were a lot of fun. Makes the subject interesting. Loves movies, and shows a lot of clips. Also, he likes to allow you freedom to think and develop, so he isn't fanatic about sticking to the prompts and syllabus, which is good. Regarding one of the previous comments, it IS possible to get A's (I got an A), and he always gave comments on our work.
helps think outside the box

This guy is great!  WTE was actually enjoyable, and I think he did a great job giving back feedback during conferences (not as much in the written comments, which we sometimes got back after turning in an updated draft).  Also, in regards the a previous comment, it is possible to get higher then a B+ from him.
Kickass
Good professor.

A brilliant writer and an amazing professor.  He has a beautiful understanding of the English language and is an endless source of methods for its manipulation.  I wouldn't be the writer I am today without him.  Easily the best professor I've ever had.
Lots of work, but a cool teacher. Talks about movies a lot and is passionate about the material. He goes out of his way to help you.
Excellent teacher. WTE was my favorite class.

honestly, mayya might be one of the worst professors ive ever had. bro's lectures were a pain to sit through with how he'd drone on and on and the tests were about rote memorization rather than learning. would never recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Mayya. Very chill, kind professor that cares and wants you to genuinely learn! I learned a lot of cool fun facts about how computers work and would definitely take his class again!
great guy. teaches very well and honestly is very clear. wants you to succeed

great prof, you can tell he genuinely cares about his students. youre allowed to miss up to 6 classes before it starts to affect your grade. during lectures he makes everything super easy to understand. i never had any prior knowledge of sql but now i learned it! if you just show up to class and pay attention, then easy A
Amazing professor--very kind and genuinely passionate about what he does, a feeling that permeates the room. He is a great guy and cares for his students.

Prof Mayya has been one of the best and most caring professors I have ever met. He cares about students and is willing to elaborate on knowledge points and grading criteria. I enjoy taking Info tech with him. I am not a super "technical person" but have no problem learning SQL or other areas. Highly recommend. You won't regret it.

I highly recommend Professor Mayya's section of TECH UB 1! He is incredibly passionate and knowledgeable about the material and explains challenging concepts clearly. The course content, SQL, Network Effects, etc., are also pretty useful. Grading is fair, and he is super accessible during office hours and genuinely wants students to exceed!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is extremely content heavy with SQL in the mix. Final Exam/Quizzes are really tough theoretically. While the content is extremely sound and super useful for a good foundation, the exams/quizzes did throw me off for a loop. Not only do you need to mug up but also understand the logical explanation. However, Prof Mayya is super kind!

Professor Mayya is a great professor who is clearly very passionate about what he teaches. His lectures are very clear and if you listen during class it should not be a difficult class. He is very accessible outside of class for office hours and willing to work with students and listen to new ideas.

Prof Mayya is a rly nice guy and is super passionate about the content & teaching. The SQL is so helpful and I've held onto it for my resume and even in job interviews. His infotech class is pretty applicable and interdisciplinary so it connects with other Stern courses too. He makes everything clear/fair and efficient, which I appreciated.

Prof. Mayya is great! His lectures were clear and engaging, and I learned a lot from the class. It's structured so that no assignment or test is weighted too heavily. He's also easily reachable outside of class, which is super helpful for some of the new concepts, and he's a very nice guy in general!

Great professor, and definitely recommend taking Professor Mayya! He was super accessible outside of class and gave great feedback to succeed in his class. He always does his best to address any concerns you have, and is supportive all around! Just make sure you are keeping up with content and follow up if you need help in any areas.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Mayya was one of the best professors I had at NYU. His classes were super structured and engaging, and the concepts I learned were inspiring for other fields and my career prep. It can be a bit tough at first, but he's always supportive and willing to help. I'd 100% recommend taking his class if you have the chance!

Professor Mayya is fantastic! His teaching style is engaging, and he explains material clearly, making complex topics in Info Tech and Society easy to understand. I learned a lot about the subject and picked up valuable SQL techniques. I'd definitely take another course with him—highly recommended!

The final exam is so hard that it is impossible to do well. He is not flexible at all or wants to help his students succeed. He is a really tough grader especially in the group project, without giving specific feedback. Also, infotech appears to be easy, but it is really difficult to take A. Just don't take him!!!
Cares about what he teaches

Professor Mayya is one of those professors who genuinely cares about your success in his class. He takes feedback seriously and does his best to accommodate to everyone's needs. Aside from that, the class content is interesting/relevant and his learning environment isn't stressful in any way. Highly recommend him for Info Tech!

he's very chill. the class is pretty easy if you're tech-savvy, the hardest thing is learning SQL and some of the abstract internet concepts but most of the class is very basic. prof does his best to make sure we're learning and getting good grades, and he gave us some make-up opportunities at the end of the semester. def would recommend.

The class is well structured and makes sure you don't fall behind with quizzes. The final and some quizzes are nearly impossible to study for since he doesn't test you on the content from class, but real-life examples and has confusing phrasing which makes the exam much harder with multiple select. Good class up until the confusing final.

He's pretty nice and approachable but the way he teaches the class is just ridiculous and all over the place. Talking about completely different things every time so the class just felt useless and didnt make sense. 
Also half the final was multiple choice questions that felt completely subjective; no way to study for the final because of that.

Prof Mayya is really passionate about what he teaches, which makes lectures engaging for students. The grading criteria is clear, and he also takes student feedback seriously. The quizzes/exam can be tough; the best way to study is to rewatch the lectures and take notes on important examples. Good luck!

Professor Mayya is a great teacher who cares about providing information that's useful and tests you on that. His class is not hard, though the Stern curve will make it a little tough to get an A. His lectures are pretty much necessary to learn, though. If you're interested in the coursework and take notes/participate you will be fine.

Horrible, unapproachable professor. He's incredibly rude and snappy over email, when asking questions, when presenting, and when giving his atrocious feedback on assignments. He likes to show a comparison of RMP 1 star v 5 star the first day of class- believe the 1 star youd be better off with a rock lecturing. Not even being dramatic. Dont take!
Professor Mayya is one of the most caring and enthusiastic teachers. He loves to teach and love his occasional jokes. Class is not hard but more dependent on how much effort you put in.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at stern, really nice and chill. Very reasonable about grading.
very clear in his grading, very approachable/ friendly, genuinely wants his students to succeed and takes feedback into account. amazing professor, highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor, very chill. Really passionate about teaching and cares about his students and wants to see them do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Mayya hands down is one of the best professors ive ever taken a class with. This is the first time he taught this class and he crushed it. I really encourage everyone to take his class! Im a musician not a coder so for me, this class opened up a new world for me. Take his class and trust me you wont regret it! :)

Professor Mayya is great. He takes a good pace in class and dives into difficult topics in a comprehensive manner. Students definitely have an increased understanding and appreciation for IT after taking his class. If you work hard (not extremely, but enough), I'd be shocked to see you get less than a B+.

Initially, I was hesitant to take this class since there was no information available however, after the first day , I definitely knew he was better than most. The grading criteria is extremely clear and as long as you do the required readings/videos, it's easy to be on track and succeed. He posts weekly updates on upcoming assignments and schedule
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Raveesh is a good lecturer. However, his in-class activities (ICA) are ridiculous quizzing things that he talked about for 2 seconds in class. Also there are just so many components to the grade: 6 ICA, 6 pre-class videos/mini-quizzes, 4 analysis, 4 HW assignments, 1 group project, 1 group report, and more! Take other profs if available.
just take anyone else honestly, cause her grading is so tough... did all the work and she still managed to give me bad scores
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Tariq as my lab instructor because of Rate My Prof, I should've listened to the sub-5 ratings. She's one of the harshest graders I've encountered, taking off points for the smallest things, like a single misspelled word. Asking questions feels like an inconvenience to her; she often rolls her eyes and has an attitude. Take anyone else.
One of the best, if not the absolute best, in the chemistry department.
She was very helpful in recitation and always can explain tough concepts.  At first, she might seem scary but after that she is very sweet and funny.

Had Tariq for recitation, she likes when you come with questions and wants you to describe your question IN THE CLEAREST way possible. However, she is very helpful and lot of gaps in my understanding were filled in.

Had her for lab and taking her again next sem. Super nice and helpful, and is a fair grader for notebooks and labs. She helps a lot during lab as she is very knowledgeable about chemistry, and she is available during lectures on Zoom if you need to ask questions. Heavily recommend
best everrrrr
If you try you will do well
She is very nice when you get to know her. She's very knowledgeable and won't mind if you ask many questions. Gives good feedback and helps before recitation quizzes.

Dr tarik is easily one of my favorite NYU professors ever! she is amazing and always willing to help. One thing i admire is her ability to answer every question, no matter how dumb it may seem because she truly wants you to do well. Take Dr. Tarik if you can! I highly recommend her :))

Dr. Tariq is a very knowledgeable professor for any General Chemistry or Organic Chemistry. I had her for Gen. Chem. II Laboratory, and the only thing was that she is on the harsher side of notebook grading. For post-labs she is hard, but since the labs are completed in the lab, she will give great guidance on how to answer the questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took this professor for 2 semesters for lab and she is the kindest person I know. She does grade strictly but this will help the students improve and learn better. She gives good feedback on how to improve and will go out of her way to explain concepts to students when they don't understand them.

Dr. Tariq is very nice. She is super helpful and kind and is willing to answer any of your questions. She is a bit of a tough grader in lab, but she does it to make sure you understand your information.

She may seem scary, but she isn't at all!!! I love Dr. Tariq so much, she is tremendously helpful in recitation and in lab. I had her for gen chem 1 and 2 and she is also a very caring person. Don't let these reviews scare you off, she really is great once you get to know her.

She is awesome. If you put in the effort she will guide you to a better grade. Take her if you ever find an opening in her class. Her sections are gone within seconds. I am still on the waitlist for gen chem ii with probably 20 people ahead of me
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Love her. Was able to joke around with her like she was a friend. She's a tough grader but makes sure you understand and learn the material. Not taking chem again cause I hate chem but if I was taking gen chem 2, would take with her. If someone sees this and has her, tell her that her favorite student from fall 2024 left the review he promised.
Take her if you want to learn SOMETHING from genchem! Not for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: As someone with no previous chemistry experience, she's life saver. Yes, she's a harsh grader, especially in lab, but for me it helped me pinpoint where I faltered the most in my understanding. If you're someone who needs specific explanations for concepts, I think you'll love her. She's valid and funny if you get to know her, very helpful too

don't understand the hate against her - if you put in effort she appreciates it!! Tariq explained things really well, and matches your energy. if you gave nothing you got nothing tbh. she's always open to questions and explains things very well tbh. PUT IN EFFORT AND SHE WILL TOO. She is YOUR BEST FRIEND (!!!) to have, esp if u want an A
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Really tough grader. You and your friend could have the same EXACT answers and she'll take off an extra 10 points because you didn't word it the way she wants it. (true story)
Not helpful during labs and is not accessible. Yes, she is very smart, but I think she sometimes forgets we are still fresh out of high school.

She was not my lab instructor but helped me so much. She took the time to answer all of my many questions and explained each one sincerely whereas my own instructor only said right or wrong and never bothered to explain. Regretted not being in her section. I hope I can get into her section for orgo next semester.

not really accessible outside of class
doesn't understand grading structure well&disappears to find answers mid-class when you ask certain questions
expects a lot from YOU-know things from lecture/to be on top of stuff, but doesn't deliver herself-disorganized deadlines, lastminute/late emails, doesn't seem to want to teach, only answers when asked
She has in depth knowledge. I asked her after class and she spent time to explain it to me. She is overall not bad compared to some of the other recitation instructors at NYU.
Do not chose whatever you do chose someone else she is just straight up rude.
RUN
Honestly she's dull and sometimes rude hated recitation cuz it was so boring just went over hw questions and doesn't really go over topics
Mehrin is Meh
If you're a porcelain vase who can't take any straight-ball hits, don't take him. Otherwise there's zero reason not to. Who needs the Comedy Cellar when you have Rob???

So much charm and joy for what he's doing, an absolute icon. 

Gives feedback bluntly but with good heart, can be tough if you get sensitive over your creative work but is so invested in making you your best artist and it never feels malicious.

Very informal and unfiltered, which isn't everyone's cup of tea, but it IS mine.

Best prof I've had!

Rob is an icon. He is the moment. You will love Rob IF: You love jokes, videogames, listening to his stories, telling him your stories, writing stories, group discussion, and keeping up with your work! He can catch your bluff if you make a lame excuse for not doing your homework. Just do it! A happy Rob will lead to a happy class.

My urge to give him 5/5 came right after a class where there was a hiccup about the potentially offensive themes of my script (which there were none). He handled it, after class, in a way so graceful -- NOT sugarcoating and siding with me, NOR the class, just pure objectivity. Gotta love a teacher with an iron straight spine!
If you have thin skin don't take him. But if you love odd ball white men who love film you will love Rob. Hes so interesting. Never failed to make me laugh and is super kind.

Rob is really lovely and clearly cares a lot about screenwriting and teaching it. That said, he has a very specific way he wants films analysed and sometimes isn't always the most clear about explaining it, which can be a bit frustrating, but other than that he showed some great films and I overall really enjoyed his class.

A professor who genuinely cares about students and the stories they choose to tell, and is able to teach structure in a way that doesn't feel limiting. I came into the class suspicious of structure and came out of it with an appreciation for it and a better map for screenplays. And he screens awesome movies (mostly (sorry Rob!)). Take his class!!

Really great professor who cares a lot about what he's teaching and is very knowledgable. Script structure stuff is inherently very frustrating to people but his feedback was always centered around the goal of helping us communicate the story we wanted to tell, which led to great feedback and discussions. Thank you Rob!

He's alright. Feedback isn't always clear and he talks to himself a lot which made us more lost. As for the content, I am more confused at the end of the semester-but also feel like I've learned a lot? I don't know. Mixed feelings.

A little inappropriate, but it made the class more interesting so that's alright. Otherwise great great teacher and he gives wonderful feedback. If he doesn't like you, you'll know. Definitely would take another screenwriting class with him if possible. Great choice for storytelling strat.

Rob's insecurity, immaturity, and lack of professionalism undermine his teaching. He frequently discusses irrelevant personal matters, uses a split persona to avoid accountability, struggles with giving constructive feedback, and admits to emotional immaturity. If he wants to keep teaching, he must become more professional and receptive to feedback
Rob is great; he always gives you detailed feedback. However, compared to other lecturers, Rob will assign more homework and tests, which is helpful.

Rob is life. Rob is our captain. Rob is the real life John Keating. Rob inspired me how to live life. Rob inspires me to work harder. Rob inspires me the joy of living. Rob inspired my love for cinema. Rob is funny. Rob is a trend-setter. Rob is a Gen-Z professor. Rob is an icon of the history of Tisch. Rob's existence justifies 4 years of tuition.

Rob is probably the best professor I had this semester. His passion is infectious. There's never a boring day in his class.

He knows when students are not putting full effort in, so don't think you can just skate by without anyone noticing. He is always dedicated to his work and he expects the same from his class.
Gives dad energy. Funny and thoughtful professor, really cares about what he teaches.

Participate and do the work and he is the nicest person in the world. Some levels of "gamer rage" visible if participation is low. His love for the subject is inspirational and contagious. Truly a Film&TV icon. Endlessly entertaining and class meme value is amazing.

I'm so happy I took Rob's Class for StoryTelling Strats. Instead of lectures like you'd do in other classes, he makes his students watch movies because he thoroughly enjoys sharing and discussing the movies that he loves.  He is the most passionate professor you'll ever have. I do wish we did more group work in his recitations.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Rob freshman year in 2019 so like, it's been a second. But I've graduated and I have time on my hands. I didn't even know what I wanted to do freshman year but he was able to have foster a sort of community of other freaks and weirdos in my class that I STILL talk to. Very cool. It's a writing class so you'll write a lot. Good feedback.

His passion for his craft is infectious and seeing how much he loves film makes you love it that much more. For beginner screenwriters, this class is fantastic at honing traditional story structure. I wish we spent more time writing (even if we only got feedback from Rob) since we only did 2 two-page exercises and the final project

Rob passion for screenwriting was infectious throughout the semester. His movie selection is amazing, from which he teaches each of the concepts he goes over in lectures. He assigns more work than other teachers, but it's always fun, challenging, and rewarding. He is quirky and sporadic, but reasonable. Do the work and he is your best friend.

Even though I had no prior experience in screenwriting, Rob made me love for it. While he may get upset, he isn't rude. The class is fun and hisscript feedback is always helpful. Among my peers in other storytelling classes, I believe our class has the strongest grasp on story structure, thanks to Rob's precise and clear explanations.

Robert is a passionate and excellent teacher. His love for films really comes through in his teaching and it's inspiring. There isn't a lot of homework and what is assigned is really fun to complete. He's a little sporadic but it adds to his charm. You do have to complete every assignment, he will not accept incomplete homework or no attendance.

Rob is hilarious, intelligent, and passionate. He is chill in class but also teaches very well and gives great feedback on work. There is a medium amount of coursework but nothing unmanageable and all of the work helps to actually get good at screenwriting and structure. I LOVE HIM.
The best professor I've ever had in history. History. I don't think a professor will ever make me connect more to the subject of the class the way he made others connect to his course.

Morton is a really kind and cool professor who really cares about his students and the subject he teaches. Highly suggest taking this class. He also shows great films and loves to talk to students about anything film related before or after class :)

Ignore the haters, Rob was easily my favorite professor this semester, the GOAT fr. W movie screenings, W writing exercises, W constructive criticism. Rob is the kind of professor I want to try and keep in touch with even if I can't take his classes again.

I really love Rob ! Honestly he is very caring about his job and sometimes that is his downfall among my peers. Honestly, if you want to become a scriptwriter or love being in film school, PLEASE TAKE ROB ! He's a gem and oftentimes unappreciated because he does care about his job and his students. Just complete the assignments and attend class.

What a great teacher. Clear that he cares so much for his students, and the art of storytelling. He is very supportive, and wants you to succeed. His feedback is honest and fair, always constructive. A really great speaker as well, makes class interesting. Wants to work with you to push you to your best. Great class for anyone interested in writing

I love Rob! Such a fun and good-spirited guy. His class was my favorite. Always kept it real and gave constructive criticism. He teaches a lot about storystructure. For the majority of the class, we analyzed films and filled out story structure worksheets.
Rob is a total character, he is super funny which makes the class engaging. Good taste in movies.

Rob was an amazing teacher for Storytelling Strategies. His passion shone through every lecture and he gave great, honest feedback on our scripts and script analyses. He can be a BIT intense sometimes, but know it's just because he wants you to care as much as he does. He'll help you grow your writing skills and a thick skin.

You might enjoy Robs long talks about his love for film. He is such an anxious father, it's endearing. Can be prone to passionate outbursts and misses the mark on some politics; hes human. Easy class. Great movie selection. In terms of criticism; he's one person, not a god. Grow a thick skin and understand that he is one voice of many.
Rob is great! He cares a lot about his students. Sometimes he can come across as strict, but he's a good guy with really good advice. He shows really good, diverse films. Would recommend!

If he's in a good mood he's great and shows great films. However, he often will put you on a pedestal just to completely ostracize you. He doesn't ever give constructive criticism, it all just comes off as mean and aggressive. If you say something he specifically doesn't like expect a complete immature temper tantrum in front of all your peers.

I do like Rob, and when he's in a good mood he's great. However, if you do something wrong with your script his feedback is very harsh and passive aggressive. I've learned a lot and think he gives great advice, but the way he gives makes it seem more mean than constructive. I recommend this class but don't mess up.

I admit that Rob is good in person, but not as a professor in class. Hes caring and treats us like friends but whenever it comes to criticizing scripts it doesnt feel like hes supportive but rather he gave me the feeling of being discouraged. He doesnt seem like remembering his criticisms and comments before and always is unsatisfied with us.
Rob loves his job and it really comes across when he teaches his class. Probably the best teacher to get for storytelling strategies.

Rob is my favorite professor I have ever had. Our class felt like a close-knit family - I always felt that he cared deeply not only for our work, but for us as people. He's inspired me to want to be a professor myself. If you can take his class, then take it.
Rob Morton is the freaking best. If you can take his class take his class. He's an amazing teacher and a wholesome dude.

Rob honestly became our father. No joke. He is an amazing professor and gives wonderful and thought-out feedback on your scripts. The environment was fun and I felt comfortable sharing or receiving critique. If you have the chance to take Rob, do it. He's funny, tells awesome stories, teaches you story structure and how to write scripts. He's great

Rob is an amazing professor. He is hilarious, and he's easily been my favorite of my entire freshman year. He's tough on deadlines and really urges participation in class, but he's so understanding and knowledgeable. Picks some fun movies for class, too! Definitely choose Rob if you get the chance to.
Rob is such an amazing prof. Looked forward to his class every week. His passion for what he does makes the class so much better.

Rob is amazing for Storytelling Strategies! He gives helpful feedback on fixing your script and screens awesome movies! Take this class if you love coming of age movies and lots of talking and discussion.
Rob is one of the best writing professors I've met by far. He gives great feedback and he always tells you how to fix what is wrong. He is hilarious and overall a great person.

He's passionate in lectures but Rob got more mean spirited in the recitations, told people they didn't belong in this school, brought in inappropriate outside details about his personal life and made someone in his lecture cry after keeping us all in his lecture for 50 minutes after class end during finals week. Don't feel like I learned much.
everything dude said in this class was like, "yes, obviously!". so thoughtful and invested in the class. strongly recommend.

Love this guy. Makes things clear, pushes you to do your best, and is very fair. Never says "It isn't working" wout saying WHY. If he's hard on you, it's because he wants everyone to do their best including you. Not afraid to admit when he's wrong. Picks great movies for class.

Rob made my semester. As a teacher, he will be there for you for any question, suggestions, and advise on how to write your script. He is also so easy to relate to as a human that you will enjoy yourself in his class and lectures. He will tell you how awesome something is in your work while also pointing out your drawbacks. He is great! Recommend!
Rob is awesome! He's fun, expressive, and knows his stuff! I enjoyed his class a lot and would recommend. I am hoping to take another class of his again.

The course itself is very basic and easy. Rob shows movies during the lectures (for which he has a very good taste), and therefore they can be a bit long. The recitations are fun and he has a great sense of humour, he is always open for discussion, and was surprisingly honest and direct in his critiques of our scripts, which I respect a lot. Great!
Definitely one of the most inspirational professors I've had so far. Storytelling strategies has been a blast because of his recitations! The movies he showcases during lectures are amazing.

The best goddamn teacher. Learning is more important to him than your grades. You watch GREAT movies in the lecture. The recitation is really engaging and he is hilarious. Granted it's only my first semester of college, but he is my favorite teacher so far.

Rob is the best professor I have had at NYU. He's an incredibly talented teacher that inspires great work. He teaches screenplay theory well and provides helpful, thorough feedback. His class is a lot of hard work that will make you a better writer. If you get the chance to take him, do.

Rob is one of the film department's best teachers. He is incredibly joyful and funny to have as a teacher, and obsesses over helping you make YOUR script become the best it can be, staying true to your vision. Rob's really knowledgable and very easy to talk to, not just about writing, I couldn't recommend him enough! Great guy, and best teacher.

This guy is the man! Very helpful and he really knows his stuff. I recommend taking him for any screenwriting class you may have. He's positive, upbeat, and really listens to what you have to say. He isn't afraid to admit when he is wrong either. Take his class!!
Morton's class is long, yet easy- movie selection however, was not the best. Really awesome nice guy.
Rob is an awesome teacher! He really cares about furthering your abilities as a writer.  I'm giving up my Fridays to take another class from him!

Rob is one of the best professors in Film & TV. Incredibly helpful and creative, his lectures and classes are always interesting. I am going out of my way to take another class with him. If you get opportunity, take a class with Rob!!

The most lovable, nice, charming, funny professor in the writing program. Extremely knowledgable in all that is concerned with writing and picks really great films to show in lecture. Dissects the structure to a T and really knows his stuff. Wants you to learn, wants to help you improve your writing as much as possible. HIGHLY recommended.

yes, he's difficult and harsh. but honestly, he's harsh bc he cares. he humbles you to prepare you for life (beyond operating systems). the ppl that complain about him are ppl that just want an easy A. if you put genuine effort and time into it, you'll be fine and you'll learn a lot. he's a great lecturer and is very charismatic
If you already know all the material you'll still do poorly. He won't teach you anything, and won't grade you justly on what you do know. Makes everything so hard and enjoys putting people down.
Bad teacher, makes things very very difficult to understand

This class is already difficult by nature and he seems to try and make it harder for students to understand. Lectures are generally informative but the amount of work he assigned outside of class was ridiculous and made it impossible to have time for any other classwork.
If you're confident in your skills, you definitely shouldn't miss his class. The labs are tough and he grades strictly, but he's the best lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment:
By far the best lecturer I've had at NYU. Walfish is big on understanding the material and not just knowing it, and it shows. If you read and understand the textbook before each class, you will get the most out of the lectures.

And if you really put in the time, you won't find the exams that bad. There's also a huge class curve at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i learnt a lot from this class. if you want to become an expert in OS, take him.

This one is a tough grade, because on one hand he is a great lecturer, is very funny, and is very accessible to receive help from, but on the other hand his grading style feels far too stringent, with the average of the first midterm often falling below 50 or 40.

Only take him if you are serious specifically about becoming a systems programmer.

Amazing professor who's very knowledgeable in this field and uniquely able to explain hard topics clearly. That said, only take this class if you're passionate about CS and not in any other hard courses. Exams are weighted heaviest by a lot. If you start labs early, go to office hours, and study religiously for exams, this class is very worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He actually made me realize how not very intelligent I am! Good luck!

Don't take it if you already have tough courses. 
This course will probably take up all of your time and energy. However, if you do exactly as he says (do his readings, homework, and labs diligently), you will have a great time. 
It took me a while to figure out why he does things the way he does, but it makes a lot of sense now.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: RUN! Take anyone but don't him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely poor at teaching. His notes didn't go into details at all and besides the notes, all materials on operating system he provided is the textbook, which was long, vague, boring and not helpful. And he even said that some of what textbooks said was wrong. So why didn't he prepare his own materials? He didn't want to help students at all.

Michael is so far the professor with the best lecture skills I've ever met. His lectures are impressive, humorous, and inspiring, and he is a very knowledgeable and friendly person. But yes, CS202 is itself an extremely difficult topic, and he does provide tough labs and exams. So if you want scores, avoid him; if you want to learn, pick him!

Yes, CS202 is a hard class. The mean of exams are usually 50/100, and requires ACTUALLY understanding the content to excel.

However, if you are willing to put yourself through the (possible) pain of using your brain, and put effort into the labs, you are going to get the BEST lecture you r ever going to get at NYU, and a solid OS understanding.
I don't know, if you can't teach a class without assigning ridiculously long readings multiple times throughout the week, maybe you shouldn't be teaching certain topics/classes!

Hardest class I've taken at NYU. The tests were incredibly difficult and he expects you to have a deep understanding of every single concept.

He's incredibly smart and a good professor (though probably overqualified), but sometimes overcomplicates things to flaunt that he's smart.

Prayers to anyone who has to do lab4 in the future

The best professor I have ever encountered, extremely knowledgeable, classes are fun; although at times challenging. But OS is supposed to be this way.
