Just buy the most expensive equipment, keep increasing your coffee prices, and show up, and you'll get an A. He also said in class the lowest score you'd get is like a B+ if you try and he'll try his best to curve for your benefit.

He is so so sweet and he doesn't give grades below a B-. There is technically a lot of homework but you can definitely get away with not reading the textbook assignments and just paying attention in class. The case memos are super short (1 page) but the tests are pretty hard and he could work on the study guide's clarity.
Poor materials for text tell you to read more than 200 pages for multiple choices in tests and read about 30 practice short answer questions to prepare for FRQ and case reading.

It is a very short Summer Online Course. The amount of work is not worth the class. Please PICK ANOTHER TEACHER. You can try really hard, however, your grade will still NOT be the one you want. He is a very vague grader, will take off a massive amount of points because he "wanted more" in a section of a paper/final.

Do not take this professor for Senior Capstone. Subjective grader, teaches you nothing, extremely vague instructions for the projects we worked on. Very unhelpful and pains me to this day that I paid tuition for this class that barely ever met because he would replace classes with optional office hours. He does not care about your learning.

Took him for business simulation. Very tough grader. quarter of the class dropped out or opted for pass or fail after he announced that the course will be "curved" only top thirty percent can get an A or A-. Don't think anyone got an A in the class.

He was ok, I didn't love the class but it didn't negatively impact my life. The lectures aren't interesting but the information is easily accessible. Only graded by exam and final group project, both seem intimidating but were fine. He's a nice dude. Could be much worse for a BEMT requirement. The course was organized well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please for the love of god do NOT take him for EMI! He is intelligent in his work and seems sweet but he was such a tough grader. His lectures were way too dense and he demands so much. Papers and exams will have you ripping your hair out. I was 100% convinced I was going to fail and considered dropping my BEMT minor. For your GPA and sanity, run.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Narayanan is a great choice for Intro to Marketing. His lectures were pretty involved, with many case discussions and opportunities to participate. The tests were pretty hard and time-constrained, but with a lot of memorization and studying they are definitely doable. Drops your lowest test score so you have some room for error.

This class was very interesting, and the professor did a good job facilitating discussion about cases and topics. Some of the lectures were a little dry, but overall a good experience. Workload is light, most of your grade is 1 exam so make sure you do well on it (50%) and make sure you also do well on the case write-up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sometimes I wonder if he curved my ISP grade wrong. I got As on the papers and presentation (70% of the grade), but a B on the exam (30% of the grade), and ended up with a B+ in the course. If this is correct, then the curve is insane in this class. His instructions are very vague, and the grading is shrouded in mystery

I had him for ISP. His grading criteria is very unclear, and his TA was unresponsive. We weren't allowed to review anything after it was graded. He docks points for not including things in your papers that he made sound optional before. He is a tough grader. I scored higher than the class on everything except the exam and ended up with a B+.

Professor is a nice man but the instructions for each assignment are not clear at all. An extremely tough grader and class lectures don't help with assignments. He expects way more than he lets on, don't take class unless you want to hurt your GPA lol.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Nice man, but his online EMI class was probably the most boring course I have ever taken. Literally nothing in class was relevant to any assignment, and he just talked at the class for an hour over a slide deck from 2010. Class basically consisted of writing a couple case-based papers and a take-home exam on your own.
Class was not what I expected. Class material was not helpful in writing the major papers for the class. Tough grader and expects a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: What a G. Very sweet. Quite engaging on the subject matter, though his lectures could stand to be more linear. HW is very easy: very interesting, one reading a week or less. Only 2 papers: both require significant effort and critical thinking. IMO, the difficulty of the exam + midterm is MORE than compensated by the light volume of work.
Sunder is the best! Had a great semester. Learned a lot (he explains so clearly) and enjoyed myself. Assignments were not too hard and he gave us all an extension for the strategy report.

He's a caring, funny professor. Highly recommend him for EMI, he made the content easy to understand. He is very straightforward about the grading, only problem is that only 30% of the class can get an A and everyone else gets in the B range but that might just be Stern rules. Workload is very manageable.

Prof. Narayanan's class was such a pleasant surprise for me. I was very intimidated on the first day, and though the class was just as challenging as I anticipated, he made lectures interactive, funny and entertaining. He definitely cares if you are late to class, but overall he's a reasonable and solid professor. Really enjoyed this class!

I had Sunder for Entertainment and Media Industries. He's a nice guy and he's clearly very knowledgable- but the structure of the class wasn't too great. He kinda just talks at you for the hour and you read cases and quickly discuss them. The work itself isn't too much though. The final is kinda ridiculous cause it isn't really cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Business Simulation is a 2 credit course in which you get to run a coffee shop. Your grade is dependent on how your shop does and your ending report. The class is curved so it all depends on how you do relative to your class. Prof brings up interesting points that make you think about a small business and strategic decisions. Fun class! (meets 3x)
Funny and good guy. pretty easy. group project is very manageable but long. final exam is fairly graded but extremely tiring on the hands (way too much writing)
Lecture topics were interesting, not too challenging, and just a bit boring. Workload was not too heavy, right for a 2-credit class and fun if you're actually interested in the class.
Professor Narayanan makes his grading criteria fairly clear at the beginning of the semester. The workload isn't too heavy and he helps you prepare for the exam really well.

He's pretty boring although the class content is interesting. He takes attendance every single class, but lectures aren't teaching you anything you probably don't already know. He's not terrible, and the class was a good GPA booster so I would still recommend.

Narayanan has been one of my favorite professors at NYU. He is really easy going and understands the appropriate workload for a 2 credit class. He was fairly flexible with assignments and attendance. The grading criteria was also very clear, which made the class easy to do well in. Our class was fun and mostly discussion based.
he's really nice and understanding of his students. workload isn't too hard or too much. would recommend
Good Introduction course
Sunder does not make an effort to connect to students-talks at you and is pretty boring. Class work is easy.

Really nice professor. First half of the course is boring and you just go over slides. Second half is more fun and you just watch or give presentations. Very easy class. He's also very interested in his students.

the class is easy as hell as i've been getting 100's on the quizzes (3 worth 20% each of your grade). HOWEVER, the guys below be must be playing a sick joke, b/c sunder assigns more reading than any other prof i've ever had. you will only do well if you read EVERYTHING AND KNOW EVERY LITTLE DETAIL FOR ALL THE CHAPTERS HE ASSIGNS.

I love this man. He was funny, engaging, and was very straightforward with his expectations for the class. He realizes that it is an introductory course; therefore he does not bombard you with readings or any other crazy assignments. Attendance however, is MANDATORY, which is understandable since the class only meets once a week. Excellent prof!
Very good professor
He's boring. There are 2 group presentations/projects and a take home final. It's not hard but not particularly enjoyable either...
No Comments

He is not a very good teacher.  He simply reads off of his powerpoint slides which are available on blackboard so there is no point in attending class.  He does not engage the students and, although he is a nice person, doesn't make it an enjoyable experience

Professor Xenakis is knowledgeable, but the class is mentally draining. She lectures for hours without meaningful breaks. Despite appearance she actually  has little consideration for students. Concerns about a 2-hour placement were dismissed with no support. I felt discouraged, not guided, and dismissed. Would not recommend.
I want to give her a 10 if I could

As a first-year MSW student on the two-year track, I enjoyed taking Practice I with Professor X. She is welcoming and approachable, with a strong work background in social work. Assignments are manageable, and she's always available to discuss. She's thorough with every task. The class prepared me well for my placement, and I highly recommend it!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: KINDEST WOMAN EVER!!! She just wants students to care, so participate, act like you really know the material, and be friendly, and you will do amazing. Barely any graded work, all of which are very easy

most honest review of roberta newman:

she is great, currently taking her and i wish i could take her forever. yes she isnt tech savvy, could get off track sometimes, and loves to ramble, but she is just authentically her all the time and its apart of her charm 

super light grader, cares about her students and is passionate about everything.

I had a medical issue towards the beginning of the course and this is the one professor that was extremely caring. She truly cares about the success of her students and is looking to connect with them. One of the most wise people I've met and the lectures were so fun to listen to!

prof newman is sweet and funny! her grading criteria is clear and although she may ramble a lot in class, it makes the lectures actually bearable as it's not just an overload of info at once. the exams and projects are also pretty straightforward. take her!

I just would try to find someone else to take. She is very much not tech savvy as much as she claims to be. 25% of the class would just be waiting for her to set up and login to Brightspace. The readings were not that intriguing. 2 essays, one final project, a midterm, and a final. Be there for lectures or then the 
midterm/Final will be difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof newman is soooo nice and sweet! She is easy to follow, and the content is super interesting. Following along will definitely get you a good grade.
Nice lady, but your grade depends on if she likes you or not. unclear lectures, little guidance/criteria given for essays and projects.

I personally loved Prof Newman.  She does definitely pick favorites, so be sure to participate so that she likes you.  She's a very very interesting person and a sweetheart if you talk to her.  She can be harsh sometimes on grading if she doesn't like you though

She's not a bad professor, but I get the impression that she dislikes my dog, so if you have a pet, I wouldn't recommend taking her course. She also talks a lot, throws tantrums, and does not allow students to talk too much.

She's really sweet and caring. And you can tell she's a great person. She knows what she's talking about, and she talks a lot so you don't really have to talk either. But if she stops talking and asks the class a question, she'll sit there until someone answers her. If I HAD to take her again, I would.

Super sweet professor, super boring and easy class. There was very minimal content but personally I enjoyed having such an easy A. She's chill and funny and sometimes disorganized but apologetic and makes up for it. Prepare to speak in class like once per session though.

BEST PROF! She always tried to help students improve their grades; she even made the final optional and allowed cheat sheets! Her lectures are hilarious, and she only cares about your engagement. She based her grades on effort, so you could get an A even if you got a C on the midterm. Graded by a few things: 1 Paper, 1 Project, 1 Exam. TAKE HER!

AVOID. The majority of the class is Newman blabbering on tangents with seemingly little relation to what you are learning. Little set guideline or instruction. Lectures leave much to self-interpretation, but Newman will grade you badly if you do not interpret something the exact same way she does. Arbitrary and harsh grader. Favors a few students.

Passionate about subject matter but stay away, not fair or kind. Bulk of grade was final take home essay that was arbitrarily graded with no framework and resulted in low grade. I pushed back and she blew up about it to the point that I had to take up with Dean for a regrade that resulted in a A-.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love her. She is so accommodating and sweet, and at least for our semester the final was not mandatory, basically an extra credit assignment. As other people have said she does tend to go on tangents but I had no issue with it.
Best professor ever!

She really is a cool person! She loves her job, and she is fun to listen to, but the class is extremely lecture heavy and can get off-topic. She is upfront about being a harsh grader, but it's still possible to get a good grade you just have to put in the effort. Also just do the short readings and participate here and there you will be fine
The worst professor.

I like professor Newman! You can tell she genuinely enjoys what she teaches about and likes to engage the class. She's funny, but can go a lil off topic. Few assignments, but worth a lot, so make sure to work hard on them. Not super clear on grading criteria/organized, but still able to get good scores. Provide thoughtful + clear insight in ur work
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Newman is really fun! I took her for both CF1 and CF2 and both classes were really enjoyable. Her enthusiasm towards the subject was contagious, and it made it easier for me to write papers, participate in class, and engage more. Her class retains its quality over Zoom, although I think that the classroom experience is the best.

I took her for CF1 and CF2. So caring, she wants her students to do well. Participate in class! She will love you and your class if you just show you are putting in the effort. Go to her office hours and she will guide you in the right direction for written assignments. Love her, love her class, can't say enough great things about her!

Professor Newman cares. It is very evident that she wants her students to do well and she genuinely enjoys being around her students. To do well in class, participate. Meet with her about papers. Spark up conversations with her and you'll do well. However, I was incredibly bored in this class. I hated going to class. Pick a different professor.
she is fine but sorta boring (+rambles) and sometimes a hard marker

At the beginning of the semester, I thought that I had made a mistake by taking Prof Newman; but it turned out to be just the opposite. She is really funny and although she can come off as being a hard-ass she is kind and appreciates people who do the reading and participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Generally in both CF and SF all you have to do is read and you're usually good. Newman is a great teacher, really cares, lectures are fun and if you're confused about something you can ask her. Not that hard to follow her in class, it can be entertaining but sometimes boring but overall GREAT TEACHER.

Roberta is an amazing lady! She's such an intelligent human being and extremely passionate when she's teaching her students. You'll definitely leave her class feeling like you've learned so much. You must go to her class. She loves students who participate and question the material they're reading. Do the readings and put effort into your papers!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: This was the only bad teacher I had at NYU. Sure Newman knows a lot about baseball but grading papers arbitrarily based on whether or not you like someone on a personal level is juvenile. Also, she loves making off-color quips nonstop. She gave me a C- on the final paper and called it a disaster. I had another professor grade it and he said A-...
She is the best. Participate, do the reading, engage in her class and you'll be good.

Prof Newman is simply the best. 2 papers, 1 final project. Readingmovie watching for every class. Incorporates a lot of film, not "too much work." She genuinely cares about her students and about the material. Very inspirational. Grades based on effort and allows you to have your own opinion. Reads drafts and gives very helpful feedback. LOVE!

Class lectures are frustratingly random, but tries to keep the class interesting. Very helpful if you go in for office hours and takes an interest in her students. Grade based on essays (no assignmentsexams), will have readings for each class but they're not too rough

Really enthusiastic professor who genuinely cares about your learning. She gives out drafts and if you are really struggling she will do her best to try to help. She is a really eccentric character which makes the class more fun!

Enthusiastic, knowledgeable and hilarious prof. Not difficult at all and fairest grader ever. Prof. Newman is an awesome must have professor. She's crazy in an amazing way. She's always willing to help you too. Send her drafts and you'll get A's on your papers because she'll tell you how to improve your writing. Be yourself and enjoy the class!
Fun class. DIFFICULT grader.

Although she is a tough (but fair) paper grader, Prof. Newman gives chances to bring grades up through rewrites.  She also does students a favor by putting such a heavy emphasis on class participation, which can bring up your grade quite a bit.  As long as you READ and PARTICIPATE, you will definitely like this class.

Although she is a tough grader on papers, Prof. Newman gives plenty of chances to bring those grades up through rewrites.  She also helps you out by giving class participation a heavy influence on your grade, so DO THE READING and most importantly TALK and you will like this class.

Anyone who complains about Newman is obviously stuck in high school. She is the epitome of an amazing college professor. Yes, she's a tough grader sometimes but she gets you to grow up and realize that tests aren't matching or multiple choice and essays actually have to make sense. Funny and sweet. Go to her for extra help! Very brilliant.
tough grader when it comes to papers. participation counts!

So I had her for GSP Social Foundations and while I liked her I hated the class and felt her grading was difficult. I also had her for a topics course and as a topics teacher she is amazing though. Participation= way better grade! Very smart woman and really interesting. Projects were fun and best of all there were no tests.

Avoid this professor at all costs! She is dreadful and completely full of her 'brooklyn' self. Ridiculously hard grader who will allot A's and C's not on the content and quality of essays but whether or not you are one of her favorites! Take any other topics class, this is by far the worst professor in the GSP staff and the worst I've had at NYU!!
She was unorganized. She changed the syllabus many times throughout the semester. Her grading doesn't make sense. When you do the exact opposite of what she says, she'll give you an A.

one of the best teachers here. she knows what shes talking about, doesnt impose her opinions on anyone and is full of little random facts. i loved her. shes a bit of a hard grader, but if you work a little bit in her class and PARTICIPATE your fine. like i said aweseom teacher

She explains everything from scratch.  I learnt an enormous amount of things.  She'll always help you and the classes are interesting.  The only ones so far where I haven't fallen asleep.  You don't have to be on time on your readings as long as you eventually do them.  WOrk hard and you'll thrive.  Don't use cliffnotes, she knows them by heart.

Newman is still a fantastic teacher.  If you don't like her, it's probably because you didn't try or show up to class.  She likes the people who go to class and gives interesting reading and writing assignments.  A fabulous, brilliant professor.
absolutely do not take this teacher, she is crazy and unhelpful, a hardgrader and picks favorites. shes mean and weird, the class is so boring and you don't even do well..take anyone but her
SHould definatly be teaching topics classes for people who truly care about the subject. If you dont have an extensive knowledge of the material before you take the class dont bother.

Newman is so out there but one of the funniest professors I know.  She is late pretty much every day but is so brilliant that it doesn't matter.  Definitely knows her stuff and is open to your ideas.  Big on class discussion so read the assigned material.  She also accepts drafts of papers before they are due so SEND THEM.  It's so helpful.

The baseball class is a joke.  A rather boring joke, but a joke nonetheless.  Since this is a req. anyway, go ahead and take it.  Not hard on grading, as long as you realize she definitely knows her stuff.  She doesn't care if you fall asleep, and you don't have to do the reading because the trivia quizzes don't count for anything.
GREAT LADY. GREAT TEACHER. So smart about everything. She is very passionate about what she teaches. Take any class she teaches -  a GSP gem!

The classes aren't dull because we just look at ads the whole period. This class is a complete waste of time. The first class at NYU in which I learned absolutely nothing in. She pulls grades out of her ass at the end of the semester.

she really does rely on discussion, so if you are shy or don't like to talk during class, I wouldn't recommend it, since she grades on your participation as well.  Plus, she a bit tough on papers. But overall, she's passionate and interesting. A lot of ppl love this class.

the baseball class is seriously flawed, but it is still, in essence, an actual class where basically just talk about baseball, and thus, should be taken. disgusting hard on for the yankees. extremely easy class if u show up. plus she looks like a mix between kyle's mom from south park and the baby sitter from the old school simpson's episodes
awesome lady! Awesome class!

I looked forward to going to this class, it was so much fun and she made the topic really interesting. The readings were also good, there were two papers, and a big final project. She is a fairly tough grader on the papers.

Very nice and interesting teacher, going to class has never been so fun. Although side tracks alot of times, the books we had to read were great books, so even though we dont discuss it, it's fine. Loved her class

She's knowledgeable and passionate about what she teaches. But, she focuses too much on discussion. If you want the possibility of an A, talk a lot and be able to focus most of your time and effort on this class. Those who do well tend to be those who are interested in English or Art History.

Roberta def knows her stuff, but I personally don't care for her style. Although very knowledgable, she deviates greatly from the syllibus, and I often feel as though class discussions roam out of control. She's a tough but fair paper grader.

This class was a complete disappointment. It could have been could if we'd done what the syllabus said:  examine baseball and society and their interactions.  But, we talked about the Yankees every bloody day.  A complete waste of money
The woman knows what she's talking about. She also has a lot of inside connections with the baseball scholar community. Tons of reading though, and a tough grader when it comes to papers.
she is very kind but relies too much on class discussion for the lesson. she doesn't use enough examples even though she knows what she is talking about.
tough but she make dull material interesting
They were such harsh graders

FOR THE LOVE OF GOD, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

This class single-handedly drained my soul and made me question several of my life choices. A large portion of the lectures is basically them reminding us that we are in a Top 10 school. They don't know how to teach properly, but they sure know how to grade harshly.
NYU don't torture your students this way
this class makes me question why i worked so hard to come to NYU.

this course is ragebait.

reviews.comment: Please, please, please avoid taking this class if you don't have to. I cry a little every time I enter that lecture room. MCC kids who have to take this course, godspeed.
wish I could give this prof a zero.
I literally cant even stress this enough. Do everything in your power not to take their classes. Genuinely have never hated my life more. Like I'm so serious
Don't take history of media with them. You will regret it
You fail test you fail class and tests graded extremely harshly.
If you want to have a hard semester, take this class
I wish they wouldn't make a class thats so hard to pass, negative attitude, extremely passive aggressive and rude

reviews.comment: They're the worst avoid if you can
flat lectures, lot of hw, handwriting notes (no computer allowed), 4 midterms (u can drop one) based on lecture STUDY!!!
Awesome lectures.  Very knowledgeable.
Learned a lot. Test were kind of hard and there were 4 of them. You fail test, you fail class. Learned a lot tho and my TA was super nice, without my TA being nice would have gotten a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Graded by 3 "midterms" and a final. The class was sort of interesting, but lectures sometimes fell flat. The professor was extremely kind and accommodating-- great class if you have a learning plan.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was not a fun class to go to. There was so much potential to make these topics interesting, but the way this professor taught them fell short.

Grading is pretty lenient (get to drop two homework and one test) besides on the test FRQs. Although attending isn't mandatory (for lecture or recitation) its important to take notes from lecture because that is where most of the answers for the FRQs will be. Also make sure to get a good TA otherwise this class will be a nightmare.
If you're good at taking notes and taking tests you will do very well in this class, if you're more of an essay-type person you might struggle.

Attendance optional but since her slides are mostly pictures, going in person and taking detailed notes is important. You get to drop your lowest test grade and 2 lowest source exercise grades. The FRQs have really strict grading criteria so having a good TA that goes over important course content in rec is important. Keaton really helped a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have ever had. Tries to be cool but comes off super corny.

The class is easy, it's like AP World/APUSH mixed in with media history. The prof is nice but the lecture is disorganized and easy to dissociate from, and then the slides are just pictures so you can't acess the material even if you were in class. The grading criteria is so difficult to understand. If you get lucky with recitation you might be ok

The professor is a good person. Lectures make studying difficult because the lectures are only pictures; if you miss the info spoken then you just won't have it. For exams, the grading is so specific that it makes it hard to get certain points; the graders look for key words.
not a great lecturer and has unrealistic test grading rubrics

While I appreciate how self-aware and approachable Prof. Nooney makes themself seem, the casualness of their teaching style makes their lectures wordy and quite hard to follow. They also expect a high level of specificity in our exams - which is difficult given how in-concise their lectures are. I'd avoid if possible
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this over the summer semester, so it might be a little different. Graded by 3 tests and a writing assignment. A lot of reading, but they say that they won't put anything on the test that wasn't mentioned in lecture, so I've just kind of skipped out on some of the reading and been ok. Very funny prof. Would definitely take them again!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: grading criteria for papers were very vague which is the only reason i'd say the class was mid and even annoying because feedback was unclear, but this was largely on the TA not Nooney themself. tests were based exactly on the study guides and lectures so no complaints there. very self aware as a professor which i appreciated. overall pretty good.

Nooney is so chill. The grading criteria for the exam and the essays is so clear, and the TAs are really responsive as well.
If you go to lecture, take your notes, and memorize them for the exam, you will be fine.
I'm quite sure those who graded Nooney badly didn't study for the exam.

Lots of fun stuffs, and great lectures!

RUN you have to study so much info for the tests and then most of the things you studied were a waste of time. if this is an mcc requirement, its not that bad youll be fine but if u dont have to take this- plz save yourself the stress
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Laine Nooney is an amazing professor. She is very knowledgeable and passion about the video game economics that she teaches. This summer class have a midterm and a final, she offers review guide for both of them. As long as you attend every class and take notes, you will receive a  good score. Again, your notes are very important!

Ignore the bad review below this one! Professor Nooney is a great lecturer and a super fair grader. Every lecture was interesting and I could tell that she was super passionate about her class material. Her exams are fair and she doesn't give many assignments. Definitely my favorite class that I took this semester!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love her! As long as you go to the class, take notes and everything will be fine. Two exams and one writing. The exams are pretty straightforward if you learn (all from her lectures and her lectures covers readings, so you can always go back to readings if you miss something.) And the lectures are truly fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: skip class and you'll be confused because the slides she shares tell you nothing. Exams are very specific and long. The class talks more about historical development rather than allowing you to actually engage in games and game development.
Slides had very little information, tough grader, exams were specific and detailed from readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor is not just a wealth of knowledge and expertise. Her lectures are engaging and balanced with humor, fact, analysis, and just plain fun subject matter. She keeps you interested and you learn a lot so the class is definitely worth it. She also genuinely cares about her students and makes it very evident. 100% rec. -even for non gamers.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Nooney is a fantastic professor. She's very passionate and knowledgeable about video games and teaches in a way that's easy to understand, fun, and fosters an environment that encourages us to share and laugh. She speaks pretty quickly during lecture but if you miss anything, she gives many opportunities to ask questions. Take her class!

Professor Nooney was one of the best professors I have ever had in my entire academic career. She was extremely helpful, understanding to our situations, gave awesome lectures, and fostered an open and encouraging environment to participate in class conversations, even online. If you have the chance to take her class, take it! It's 100% worth it!

Laine is an all around wonderful professor! I am in one of her Spring 2020 classes which was moved online halfway through the semester due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and she has been understanding and truly caring throughout the entire process. Laine is passionate about games, their culture, and history, and she treats students like real humans!
Callihan is a really good writing professor that allows you to interpret her prompts through your own lens. Shows lots of love

She is an excellent professor, and I was very grateful to have her last semester. While expectations can feel open-ended at times, she is very willing to guide students who seek feedback and ask questions. She grades rigorously, but her comments help point you in the right direction and encourage improvement over time.

Professor Callihan came back to teach this semester and I could not have been more grateful. Use her comments and advice when writing, they are very helpful. The work can take a while but is meaningful and fun. Also, please talk during lecture, it gets very awkward when people just sit there. She is very accessible outside of class in her office

I am a good writer but the professor is incredible. She is so supportive in all aspects even let us out of class if we had an exam that followed her class. She understands that this is class is one of our lowest priorities but she expects you to show up and try your best. Always participate that helped me increase my grade.
Amazing Prof!!!! Love her. She's literally the sweetest and is so helpful. Thank you for a wonderful semester.
She is truly one of the best expos professors. Her feedback made me a better writer.
She is an angel. She is very inspiring and supportive. She is the best. You will be grateful if you can take her course.

Took Nicole's class for two semesters (Expos-UA 4/ 9). I'm not a great writer, but Nicole helped me improve by a mile. Gives great feedback and cares a lot about her students. Very accessible during office hours & can talk to about anything even if not class-related. I'm a STEM major, but writing the essay w/ Nicole was the highlight of freshman yr

Amazing professor with a marvelous sense of humor. Extremely enthusiastic about the material and made me genuinely excited to come to class. The course is structured very creatively, from presentations to pitching Op-Eds. She's very encouraging and gives excellent feedback to help you improve as a writer.

Nicole is a really sweet person. She cares her students, understand them, and most importantly she prepared class material and revise essays really carefully. Can't think of any professor better than her!

I would take her again if it fit in my schedule. Shes really sweet and caring. I would definitely recommend her. In my opinion she could be a LITTLE unclear in what she wants you to right about but she explains it if you dont get it. Professor Callihans class isnt terribly difficult. If you can, id say take her class!
Thank you for being my teacher.

Incredible lady. Super sweet, knowledgeable, and just wants everyone to learn and be happy. Great experience in the course, which was a total 180 from last semester. The environment is happy, supportive, and I've learned so much more from her than I did last semester.

Professor Callihan is an amazing Expository Writing teacher who cares for her students. Not only is she understanding of your situation but also she really wants you to improve your writing skills. I have always found her critiques clear! She also offers many one-to-one conferences.

Professor Callihan is the perfect EXPOS instructor if you are an intellectually curious person who wants to explore the surrounding world. She always has such a profound presence in the class and her ideas are extraordinary. Truly inspiring!
Professor Callihan is always so nice and full of amazing ideas. She inspires her students a lot and really cares and listens to her students. EXPOS will be fun with her, I promise.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof. Callihan is definitely a nice lady, but if you've struggled with English and writing in high school, I don't think her class would be the best for you. Her style of teaching and grading was very difficult for me, so the class was a bit overwhelming and a tad unenjoyable since I was never a great writer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have ever had. She's very kind and energetic. I looked forward to her class and when it comes to conferences, she gives useful feedback and advice with how to write your essay. She makes writing enjoyable and she is such a wonderful person! I definitely recommend to take her class!

Professor Callihan is a great professor. She really cares about you and wants you to succeed so if you're having trouble all you have to do is go visit her and she will try and guide you. Professor Callihan is a great writing professor and she knows that we are engineering students so she does a lot for her students.

Not only is she an outstanding teacher, Prof. Callihan is a very nice person in and out of the classroom. She is always willing to help out, as long as you go to class. There's no reason to miss her class: you will always learn something and have a great time! And someday she might even bring cookies/madeleines.
Wonderful teacher; she is  helpful, friendly and pretty good at explaining things.
LOVE professor callihan. She's a star! tough grader, but she wants you to do well and tries her best to get you on the right track. And she brings cupcakes to class sometimes!
I took Personality Theories with her, and she was always super sweet and caring. Although there are not many assignments, they were pretty easy, so do not worry about it! Easy and fun class!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Taylor is the best professor at NYU--so much so I'm writing this review a year after taking the class. Personality theories taught by her was the easiest course I've taken. She doesn't try to trick you on the exams and even gives extra credit questions. She's super sweet and thoughtful--and remembers her students. Prof if you see this, I miss you.

Professor Taylor is amazing. She is so caring, thoughtful, and truly cares about her students. I took her on her 2nd semester of teaching, and she did great. We had 3 exams, but we had the option to write an essay instead of taking Midterm 2. If you pay attention in class, you'll do fine even without the readings.

Professor Orlandoni is such a caring and knowledgeable professor. Her lectures are always filled with various examples from personal experiences, research studies, and even videos creating a dynamic learning experience. I appreciate her passion and clear lectures and I learned a lot in class! She's the best!
Beyond thoughtful! A few easy assignments. Truly cares. On short notice came to teach this class.

This was the first time Professor Orlandoni has taught a class (and on very short notice, too!) and she has been AMAZING so far. Incredibly kind, truly cares about students' opinions, and took away exams upon students' requests. A few writing assignments, open response, are the majority of your grade. Easy A, as long as you show effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do yourself a favor and run.Writes in chicken scratch and talks unnecessarily fast. If you ask him a question, he'll just ask you right back. Makes things super hard to understand when this isn't even that hard of a class in the first place.

His social media presence is unprofessional, and his interactions in class often feel passive-aggressive and unnecessarily complicated. This makes him difficult to work with and creates an uncomfortable learning environment. I'm raising this because it's affecting the quality of the course.

Restored my faith in Bio dept. He humanizes scientific learning and is truly passionate about the subject material (Protein Biochem). As long as you show up and pay attention you'll succeed on exams, which test for understanding not rote memorization. Lenient grader and helpful outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very disorganized lectures, exam was very different to his claims of what would be there, TA was very helpful and only reason students did reasonably well.

Lectures are so disorganized, especially when he illegibly writes on the whiteboard. Completely and consistently misinterprets student questions and therefore doesn't answer. Test Qs incomprehensible because of phrasing/English. Impersonal. Everything I learned & thoroughly understood was because of our incredible TA. Do not take MCB I off track.

He's nice and approachable, but he's very vague on what he expects from you (especially on the research paper). The midterm quiz was terribly written because the questions were so vague/unclear and he wouldn't clarify anything. If you have a good understanding of the experiment overall, then the class is an easy A.

This is an upper bio course so the expectation is to be able to work independently in a research lab setting and think critically, so don't expect it to be a typical lecture course. However, Joe's super chill and there to help and ur working w/ others around you. 2 exams, 2 manuscripts + HW make up the grade. Learned a lot but gotta work to do well
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Honestly really chill and nice dude. Gives great feedback and would recommend him off track rather than Siegal/Ercan
Not sure why he receives so much hate, I think hes a great professor and tries his best to convey information to his students. Difficult class but hes there for you
He's tough and will make you work. But I can assure you you will learn in this class. Definitely the best class I've taken at NYU.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Osmundson has been the best professor I've had at NYU. He cares so much about his students success and allows for an amazing learning environment. If you work hard in the class you'll do well. Professor Osmundson makes complex material easier to understand and is really funny while he teaches!

Although he gave extremely challenging quizzes and assignments, he is very approachable and always willing to help! He is also very passionate about bio which makes this course (and having him as a Professor) extremely enjoyable. Be prepared to work hard for an A (even though it's a 1 credit course).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had him for MCB I. Very chaotic, disorganized lectures. Left me more confused after class than I was before. Asks way too many questions about complex material we haven't had time to even process and expects us to know the answers to all of them.

The only redeeming quality is that he's approachable. Other than that he's a horrible "professor". He has no clear grading criteria, gives ridiculously and unnecessarily hard assignments to students who are just getting introduced to biology & punishes them for it by giving bad grades. If you like science, avoid him cuz he'll drain that interest.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor. He makes a 1 credit class much harder than it should be, does not explain what he expects on assignments, and does not provide enough resources for homework and studying. Most of the students have no idea what is going on in this class.
I felt Joe was very approachable and helpful. He did make the class harder than it needed to be for a 1 credit POB lab, but I learned plenty and that's what matters.
Joe is very condescending and a much tougher grader than the other TAs. I did more work for this one credit POB lab than I did for POB itself. Avoid at all costs.
Great lecturer, lots of hw

professor is attentive and responsive in OH and after class. Exams are 80% of the grade, but I think that is just how Algorithms classes are weighted. The exams are graded very harshly compared to the difficulty of the content on the exams, but I guess it doesn't matter in the end since there is a pretty large curve on the midterm and final each.
Run for this professor
His lectures are amazing! Just be aware that two exams make up 80% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: EXAMS ARE 80% OF GRADE AND NO SIMILAR TO HOMEWORK VERY VERY HARD CLASS
Great Professor!

A truly amazing professor! Great lectures, very helpful in office hours, accessible on campuswire, clear explanations and fun demos... there's not much better you can get. The issue is the course is designed against you: two exams are most of your grade, not the weekly hw that takes hours, which is where most of the bulk of learning comes from.

Not an easy class for sure, but once you fully understand all the techniques/algorithms you have it gets better. Regev's lectures are very good for understanding the general concepts and ideas but textbook is super helpful for gaining a rigorous perspective. Regev is caring and helpful when answering questions + the class is curved very well.

Let me get this out of the way; this class is brutally difficult. It's the hardest required CS class by a mile. But Regev is a fantastic professor and a genuinely great human being. Seeing as you have to take algorithms, he is a great option that makes the material bearable. The final being worth 50% of the grade is annoying, though.
Algo is a tough class and on top of this 75% of your grade is determined by exams. With that said, Oded is amazing and made me appreciate the conceptual side of computer science.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This isn't an easy class right off the bat. You need to attend lectures, you NEED to study beforehand or you won't understand much. Prof Regev is as clear as he can be with the material, he's extremely sweet and helpful as well. You NEED to work hard to get the most out of this class, but it is so worth it! HW + exams are hard, but curved overall.
The best professor I have ever met at NYU! You can learn a lot from his course! Choose him!

Professor Regev is one of the kindest professors at NYU. His homeworks and exams are very difficult, but this is one of the few classes I feel that I learned a lot and actually remember the material I learned.

One of the nicest professors I have had at NYU. He is extremely knowledgeable and I found his lectures to be pretty engaging. Exams and HW are difficult, but I found that I left the class learning a lot (and actually remembering it LOL).

One of the few decent CS courses at NYU, the difficulty is fair for a 3xx course. You need really pay attention to the lecture and try to understand how an algorithm is designed. Get ready to spend 5-7 hours on this course.

You're gonna be youtubing to save your life, every single TA will tell you something different, every single grader will have a different metric for giving you points, and every single Office hours will leave you scratching your head, because NOBODY IS TALKING TO EACH OTHER. Everyone is giving out different advice. AVOID.

Basic Algo is a hard class, I get it. Prof regev seems like a nice person, but the structuring is all wrong. You will find yourself playing catch up at best. Lectures are simpler than weekly hws, which are mostly about self teaching + youtube. You cannot catch a break in this class, they post new hw before the current one's deadline. insanity.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have ever taken, but Regev is a fantastic lecturer and his explanations made the difficult material a lot more accessible. He's also super nice and very accessible outside of class. There is a lot of homework (weekly) which is extremely difficult and the tests are even harder, but there is also a huge curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Regev was fine but the course material itself was just insanely hard. It didn't help that the midterm+final made up 75% of the final grade and the test averages were extremely low.

Heyo! Professor Regev teaches the materials in a very engaging matter. Through his lectures, and his amazing visualization of concepts, I was able to grasp many difficult algorithm into my head. Although I did not do good in class due to VERY difficult tests, I hold no bad feelings. I hope I can find a good professor like him in the future!

Hands down the hardest CS course you'll take in the major. Conceptually very difficult to grasp and homeworks are weekly and require a LOT of understanding so make sure to read the assigned readings and notes over and over until you completely understand it. The tests are also incredibly difficult and super long so expect a very low test average.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Love him with a passion. Best professor ever. He is such a kind and intelligent guy. He loves what he's doing and he cares about the students. His lectures are so well structured that you can really learn a lot. Exams are really hard due to the materials of this course but he gives good curves. Take whichever class he teaches!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very clear lecture, excellent organization and easy to follow. The HW assigned beautifully complemented the lectures by giving the students a chance to not only practice the concepts discussed in lecture, but also to preview the next lecture's material in a very engaging manner: it guided students in thinking from the point of view of a researcher.
lectures can be kind of boring but she is very nice

Professor Ciftci is one of the most incredible professors I have taken. She cares about her students SO much, inside and outside of the classroom. I would absolutely take her again. I loved walking in and seeing her smiling face welcoming us. She also gives a lot of help when needed. 10/10 professor.

Dr. Ciftci is a fantastic professor! I've taken two of her classes and had the best learning experience. Her grading is very clear and her door is always open for feedback and improvement. If you put in the effort, getting an A in her class is very doable. Her lectures teach you a lot, and she will always support you in and out of the classroom!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Lectures are not engaging and prof speaks monotone. I wouldn't avoid her at all costs, but definitely be mindful and don't be afraid of asking questions in class. More of a strict grader but she means well.
Definitely A high school teacher. LOL

Honestly, the professor was so boring and harsh when it came to grading and participation. The topic of the class was already dull, and the class itself was not engaging. There wasn't much teaching; the professor simply read off slides, which means we could have stayed home and done it in our own time. I would not recommend this class
Finals and Essays were quite easy. However, we had group presentations that were harshly critiqued. Unclear grading, very arbitrary in a lot of ways. However, pretty easy to just float by.
Absolute joke of a “professor “ who cares more about comma pronouncing, sound rythms, and personal political opinions
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Don't trust what he says, no matter how he tries to reassure you. Just follow the syllabus and do the best you can — maybe you'll still pull off a good grade. But if you don't participate in class, there's no way you're getting a B+ or higher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Participation matters more than your essays. Very easy to do well but it is so boring.
If there are other options, never choose him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Every minute I spent in his class or in one-on-one conferences, I felt like I was getting smarter. He really challenges you to think more deeply without assigning too much work. His vibe is very intense (we didn't introduce ourselves at the beginning of the semester because he wanted to learn how we think first), but he's really caring!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super smart dude! I could listen to him talk for hours. He's strict in a way that inspires us not pressure us into exhaustion. Knows how to get our brains going, gives amazing feedback and knows exactly what to say. Sweet and funny! Honestly made me not hate writing essays!
colm o'shea is the most wonderful irish man. take his class.
One of the most interesting professors I've ever had. Class is always interesting. Tough grader on essays but will make you a better writer
I love this man. He truly cares about his students and will help them outside of class. His class was always exciting and will make you actually enjoy writing essays.

Take Professor O'Shea. I hate to write, but I genuinely didn't mind in his class. His lectures are interesting, and it's clear he cares about his students. If you put the effort in, you'll have a great semester. Much better then the other writing the essay professors, it's not even close.

Colm is a very interesting, inspiring, and smart professor in the writing department. He has critical feedback and is tough grader. He sets high standard but is willing to work with you to achieve it. I personally learned a lot from his class.

Do you want to actually put effort into a writing class? Then take this class. He's a hard grader, but an incredible feedback giver and a phenomenal professor. He will help you when you slip and make sure that you are outputting the best work you can do, so long as you put the effort in. He will not tolerate the BS and that's the best thing.

Colm is probably the best professor in the WTE department. He introduces you to so many different obscure art whether it is in fine art, music, or movies. At first, I thought he was tough and despised his class. But over the course of the semester, I grew to love what he was teaching. His challenges definitely made me a better writer.

Colm is the greatest professor I have ever had. He will make you a more intelligent, thoughtful, interesting person. He doesn't take bullshit from you or the world - always be curious and interested, and if you engage in the class you will get so much out of it. Colm was the most important figure I have had in my creative/intellectual life TAKE HIM

You can tell Colm cares about writing and his students. He is a tough grader, but his feedback is always incredibly helpful. Classes with him are also extremely educational, allowing for students to share their opinions openly.

Being super knowledgeable and smart himself, Colm will appreciate your wit as well. He is a tough grader, but he expresses what he wants from your essays very clear in class. His lecture has been the most interesting and organized lecture I have ever taken. He will let you read complex and dense but also the most thought provoking essays.

His lectures are really fun to listen to, he's insightful and very very knowledgeable. He can make any topic 10x more interesting, through your 1-on-1 sessions with him or the class workshops. He would be able to render your interest into a more elaborate essay topic.

He's a tough grader, and gets angry when the class doesn't have an answer to a question. He resorted to insults more than a few times to encourage answers rather than just let the question go. He also uses a lot of metaphors that often don't add to the conversation, he'll just repeat what a student said back to them just in a less clear way.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Colm had to be one of the most caring professors Ive ever had. The class was difficult for me personally because it was so brand new but he helped a lot. Hes also very forgiving, but still dont screw him over when you have schedules with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was so hard for me and really made me think, however I feel like I have a lot to take away. Colm is a really great professor, I was consistently shocked by how smart he is. He's a tough person to impress, but when you do impress him it's rewarding. No easy A, but you can get a lot out of his class.

Very good at giving you direction in your writing when you're confused about how to proceed. He often will take all the mismatched ideas I have in my head and give them a specific name that's a term I can research and this does wonders for my papers. He makes a very difficult task so much easier.

Colm is an inspiring professor. He comes off tough at first, but he really challenges you to come to conclusions on your own. He does speak in metaphors, which can be confusing at times, but don't hesitate for clarity. I didn't expect to enjoy an essay writing class in college, but Colm will make writing a worthwhile and beautiful experience.
Loved attending his class and I knew I would always leave the room with something to think about. Tough grader but I didn't expect any less from a college writing class.
He's fantastic. Tough grader, but a really cool guy. I enjoyed his class despite the hard work and I'd take it again.

Colm is a great professor. I loved his class, and while I didn't always love the work, he encouraged me to think critically and made the work interesting. His comments on assignments are often blunt, but he's extremely constructive during his meetings regarding your papers, and he seems like a very sweet person. I'd take WTE with him again.
Opened my mind. Chose him two semesters in a row. Truly intelligent person who will expand your thinking and communicate clearly.
You won't regret taking him. That is all I have to say.

One of the smartest people, let alone professors, I have ever met. He has such a passion for the work that he does that he makes me want to succeed. After one read through of my essay in a one on one conference and 20 minutes of discussion he was able to help me see my subject in a much clearer, and more interesting way. Simply, he's the bomb.

Colm is one of the most understanding, helpful, and altruistic teachers I've ever had. He's brilliant but still down-to-earth. WTE is notoriously tedious, but it quickly became one of my favorite classes.

Had him for my second semester of WTE and he's hands down, one of the smartest human beings I've ever met. He is incredibly demanding, but he's also really helpful and if you put in the time and the effort you'll do well. By far one of my favorite professors at NYU.

Being in ACE now I wish I could go back! Colm made sure to keep a warm classroom environment where everyone felt comfortable, which really helped. He tends to dig deep into readings-asks a lot of questions in class discussions. Very passionate about writing. Office hours very helpful, he helps push you to form solid ideas. Great class+professor!

Undoubtedly the best professor I've had at NYU. Colm is one of the toughest graders among the WTE instructors, but he makes sure to grade students according to their abilities. He is incredibly passionate about writing and about the class. WTE isn't a repeat of high school English. It's supposed to help you abandon high school techniques.

Colm was incredible. As long as you care about the essays you're writing, he'll help you make them great. Not an easy prof- he really wants you to dig in and make complicated points- but my writing definitely improved.

He's an extremely intelligent guy, but needs to learn how to instruct. He uses so many metaphors while speaking, he leaves you in some other place and you're completely lost. I had great conversations with him in meetings, but when it came down to the writing-- I was stressed beyond belief. And he a tough grader. It's a lot for your first semester.

Phenomenal teacher but an absolutely awful class. Colm goes far out of his way to help his students and is extremely intelligent. He expects the best work from his students, which at times can be hard because of the difficulty of creative analytical writing. He is a hard grader but provides great feedback. Probably the best yet hardest professor
Colm is a great professor. He is always willing to help. However, he is very specific on what he wants and he grades pretty harshly. You have to work really hard to do well!!

Colm is an extremely passionate professer who is very willing to meet w/ you outside of class or essay advice via email. He makes you work and think in ways you probably havent but it seems no matter how hard you work you never "master" an essay. I did enjoy the class but I took both AP Lit & AP Lang and I pulled a B-..take that for what it's worth

Colm is fantastic. He had changed my entire perception of writing and language for the better. I can honestly say that this is the best class I have ever taken. But that doesn't necessarily warrant good grades. He is very difficult and tries to push you to do your best.

Every writing the essay class is painful, but Colm makes it pretty much as interesting and beneficial as possible, helping and educating his students rather than preaching. Bit of a tough grader, but rarely assigns busy work, which I appreciated. Again, he makes what could be a very boring class extremely interesting: I can't stress that enough.

Heard horror stories about this class, and the first couple of weeks lived up to those expectations. But the minute I had a one on one conversation with Colm, I finally got it. Very helpful in cutting to the core of the essays you have to read. Fair warning though, if you are the type of student who hates talking in class, do not expect much help!

i had to take WTE twice during my time in NYU, once with a certain Ms. Bernhardt.  I failed her class and was very scared to take it again.  But O'Shea proved to be the professor I thought didn't exist.  He is VERY helpful and if you talk to him, you will end up realising he is the bees knees too.
Hard working dedicated professor. Expected to hate this course but it's not that bad. He opens doors and windows of thoughts. Take his class but move your ass as he gets booked up smart.

The first thing I told Professor O'Shea was that I had no idea how to write. Not only did he help me become a better writer, he honestly made the course material interesting. He's dedicated, enthusiastic, and truly invested in the development of his students as writers and thinkers. And he's cute to boot!
Great teacher...great classes...great interest. Take his class if you can you won't regret it. You HAve to put in effort to score good grades but he's helpful and fair with criticism.

Thought this would be my worse class. Turned out to be my favorite. Colm is adept at actually making literature interesting. Makes even the driest/complex of ideas MUCH clearer and humourous. I highly recommend him Im bad at writing and still pulled in a B+

He is a very intelligent and competent teacher. He is also nice and funny. He has encouraged me to think deeper than I normally would have. I have learned a lot about writing and critical thinking from having him as a professor. I highly recommend him.
Colm is my kinda professor. Interesting, fun, brilliant mind and able to make boring stuff even compelling. Heard he is a poet too. Nice and sincere.

I consider him a genuinely hard working guy. Very willing to help but wants a high standard. I like his honest feedback. Don't expect high grades for little input. Makes what could be boring more than bearable.

The best instructor I have ever had, before or since. Extremely intelligent and personable. Everyone in my class enjoyed having him. Patient in class and during meetings, and very wiling to work outside of class hours. A warning to latecomers though: he gets upset even if you come one minute late. Tardiness is a good way to get on his bad side.

My opinion might be biased, seeing as I love writing & literature, but I think Colm is creative in his teaching style, very accessible for answering questions, and also very relatable. He's never pejorative, and works easily with all genres of students. His assigned essays are interesting and really, so is he. Young, fun, Irish, and yes, cute.
He is pretty good. very smart himself so expects you to get it quickly. Very helpful when you get to know him. Can't understand negative comments as he is good. I'd take him again.

He was alright, but the course material is boring in the first place and he isn't the nicest person. He can be very unclear about assignments, though his one on one meetings were helpful. Participate a lot. If I could take this class over, I would try a different professor.
He can teach ok but this is one boring abstract course no matter what. Liked his wit.  he's honest with grading essay and is very helpful if you need him to explain.
I found him excellent. Interesting and good humour. Demanding but helpful. Take him if you can.

I had Colm for Writing the Essay in the fall semester of my freshman year. While I thought he was an okay professor, I know MANY ohters who had problems. He is extremely unclear. This is a VERY abstract class so it is important to have someone to explain things well. also he was very rude at times and laughed at students or left mean comments.

best. professor. ever. for writing the essay at least. he makes the most boring, horrible required course seem fun, and he's a fair grader. he leaves constructive comments on all your assignments and will meet with you of class to help you.

Paloma is such an amazing professor!! I had Storytelling Strategies with her in the fall, and she knows how to break down scripts so well, and knows exactly how to enhance them. She is so caring, and she is so funny. She is really great at making lecture and recitation a very collaborative space.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you're looking for constant feedback I'd probably choose someone else.

Paloma is very sweet, understanding, and funny. Unfortunately, this semester she was not as accessible outside class. She creates a very welcoming vibe to help you gain confidence in sharing your ideas. Really cares about each story and student! Participation is big. Takes attendance at the beginning of every class and recitation. 

Take Paloma!!
The actual goat.
The nicest French person you will ever meet. Actually my favorite writing professor ever, PLEASE take her class asap.

Put effort into the class and take her seriously and Paloma will be the best writing teacher you'll ever have. She had many good moments, but her best was when she realized we were all too bogged down by structure and also saw how stressed we were and screened Petite Maman for our pain. Legend.

Paloma was absolutely my favorite professor this semester. She creates a welcoming atmosphere in both her lectures and recitations that made me feel comfortable sharing my work, giving feedback, and taking creative risks. She's very supportive of her students and is readily available outside class if you're struggling or need to talk something out.

I had Prof. Paloma for both lecture & recitation. She was an amazing teacher. Paloma gives reallly detailed feedback and is always willing to read any of your work if you want feedback, you just need to reach out. She's really accommodating and loves to hear your thoughts. Take Paloma if you want a knowledgeable and supportive teacher!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Paloma is a really inspiring professor! She gives incredible feedback and is very engaging in class. She brought in a guest lecturer, showed us a nice variety of great films, and just overall made the class really worthwhile and exciting! I'd recommend her to anyone looking for a Storytelling Strategies professor.

Going into this class I was very scared of having to critique my work in a group (recitation) environment as someone not very interested or experienced in screenwriting. However, Paloma creates such a warm and educational environment that I got over my fears and really grew from doing peer critiques. Take Paloma!!

I literally altered my entire Fall schedule just to give myself the opportunity to MAYBE take another class with Paloma in the Spring. She is truly my favorite writing professor I've ever had. So, so passionate and actually excited about the work her students produce in class. She is also just a wonderful person in addition to being a great teacher

Paloma is so passionate, high-energy, and sweet. I never got bored in class and learned so much. In recitation, everybody has to share their idea, treatment, and script with the class, which can be scary, but Paloma fosters a very warm environment. The feedback you get is so valuable and she's always willing to give more outside of class.

Paloma has a great understanding of all things story structure and communicates her wisdom effectively! The class is heavily focused on discussion, which is often a crutch in other classes, but she keeps energy high and is very inspiring. Everyone feels like they have a voice in her class.

Wonderful teacher who is smart and open to discussion when it comes to writing. She is truly one of the sweetest people and an amazing teacher. She has a good understanding of structure but doesn't police it and is an amazing writer.

wonderful teacher! she's strict on punctuality so make sure to turn in work on time and don't be late to class. sometimes she goes a few minutes over the class time, but the class environment was very welcoming and open as we gave notes on each other's scripts and I really improved as a writer in her class. highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Coming back to rate him. he is such a harsh grader and no worth taking. he made suggestions during office hours and when i put them he wrote that he didnt like it. super annoying and just not worth to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice but unclear grading, lots of peer review and workshops.
Prof Polchin was great! No homework aside from a handful of approx. 300 word writings. You are graded on 2 large essays but there is plenty of time to work on them.

Super light work outside of the actual class. In class just make sure you participate and your grade will be fine. Polchin is an awesome dude, and the stuff he teaches is pretty valuable. Easy grader too.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Although Professor Polchin is somewhat of a tough grader, his class sets you up for success in the sense that there are two papers that you work on throughout the semester. This class did not cause me stress because he gives you so much time to work on your drafts, which I really appreciate. I would absolutely recommend you take him!!

Two essays, no exam, but before every class you need to write a small writing about 300 words. The workload is a lot, but Professor Polchin was very kind and helpful. NOT EASY to get an A, but participation in class will help. In general very good class, love to take him again
He was a fun professor and engaging during class, but a surprisingly tough grader. Participate or else you wont get an A lol

I do not understand all the negative reviews; Professor Polchin was great! His class is seminar-style, allowing you to connect with him and your classmates. He assigns two papers, a few short writing assignments, and, occasionally, has you peer review your classmates' writing. He makes the road towards the final draft very smooth. Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Polchin is amazing! The class is easy - just two major essays with lots of helpful feedback. He's clear, organized, and really encouraging and understanding. I looked forward to every class and am taking him again next semester. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Polchin is a very knowledgeable, kind and encouraging man. His sources and materials are interesting and captivating. He encourages a love for writing and is well organized. Light homework with no tests or quizzes. Grades are comprised of final papers as well as pre-drafts. Class is workshop heavy.

I took him for two semesters (WACI and WREX) and loved both. He is incredibly kind let me take a lot of liberty with the prompts he gave. In the spring semester, I was having a lot of issues getting to class and getting my work in on time. He was incredibly understanding and gave generous extensions. Just make sure to communicate! Take him!

only two essays but is a harsh grader. wants it to be journalistic but if it's not what he wants then you get a B. Both essays are on photography so it is difficult if you have zero interest or background in the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Polchin was good! I thought the class was pretty interesting. There is only one required book and a couple easy writing entries that help work towards the final drafts of the two essays he assigns. The in-class group workshops are helpful. Make sure you participate or at least show active listening. Would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's very nice and class is not difficult! No midterm or final and only 2 papers! There's many writing journals but graded just for completion. Papers are discussed in class with group workshops giving each other feedback. He's very understanding and different from any typical writing class! Can be slow at times but overall really great class!!

Literally my favorite writing professor at NYU. Your writing skills will improve really quickly. He's a fair grader, gives super helpful feedback, and makes an effort to engage his students. Honest but encouraging. Definitely participate in the discussions, they're more helpful than you'd think. Polchin's amazing.

Professor Polchin is truly a gem. Your writing WILL improve in this class! Participate, turn things in on time, and show that you've thought about the material. Really helps you to space out the two big projects so that you aren't pressed for time. Makes class discussion fun and engaging. Take this class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very good professor

Had a great time in his creative writing course! Fair amount of writing and reading, but nothing too overwhelming. Lots of discussion and workshops will improve your writing. He gives very clear instructions on assignments, including the midterm and final. As long as you show that you're making an effort, he's very fair! 10/10 would take again.

Professor Polchin is the best!! When I took creative writing I thought it was going to be the worst, but he taught me to love it! Hes so sweet and understanding about any issues that arise. Hes clearly passionate abt what he does. The class is mostly graded by participation, midterm, and final but he grades fairly easy. Take creative writing!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Polchin is a great soul, but his assignments are hard to interpret. I got a B+ for my midterm portfolio, but an A on the online assignment, totaling an A in the course. I wish I would have utilized his office hours at the beginning of the semester. He's intelligent, but you have to put in the effort and do your blogs. Participate!!!

He was a great professor. The class was challenging but it definitely improved my writing. He gave us two essays that were discussed in detail in class. You have in class reflections and blog posts. We read numerous articles, which could get tedious but they were interesting. Class participation is important he calls on you to give opinion.

Polchin is an awesome professor. I would have taken him again this semester but unfortunately he is writing a book. :( Anyway, he's really into participation, so raise your hand in class and do the blog posts. His assignments can be a tad unclear but if you ask about it, he'll totally clear things up

Confusing assignments. A LOT of group workshops and weekly blog post requirements added to a long list of essays we read in class. Asks you to read an essay collection, but doesn't discuss them in class. Surprisingly tough grader. Take him if you like group workshops, reading essays and no guide on papers.

Good teacher who's helped me improve my writing. He's quite lenient and nice but you have to do a lot of readingwriting and hes a tough grader. 2 big essays and then small homeworks in between. enjoyed the class- would take again.
