She just reads off of slides the whole time and drones. Classes are always incredibly long and dull and then she assigns us a bunch of busywork assignments.

The amount of homework we had at the start of the semester was rough, but she was willing to change based off of our feedback which was pretty nice of her. Grades were also heavily curved because a lot of students did not do too well.

She seems like a nice person but definitely does not understand linear algebra. It's a beautiful subject but had to rely on MIT's OpenCourseware to understand. Prof. Bhat cannot answer conceptual questions, makes many mistakes even when copying from the sheet she has, and lectures are basically her writing notes down and then reading them back.

The way Professor Bhat structures Linear Algebra online is typically one weekly quiz, one recitation worksheet, one problem set and one asynchronous assessment. Lots of work. Nice Professor. Exams do not match problem sets very well. Quizzes rely on "tricks" where HW is computational HEAVY

reviews.comment: Does not enhance/clarify your knowledge of LinAlg, making a student who isn't comfortable with the subject even more confused. Nice person, but not a great prof.

Coursework is weird, personal reflection makes no sense. Classes always run late for 1015 mins. Appear to be nice, but I do not understand why is it so hard to communicate with her individually
never take her course. Make this course the hardest thing ever. Have homework everyday, the window is very short, it will make a heart attack. The problem set extremely difficult.
Do not take her class!!! She only repeats the textbooks in a more confusing and difficult way. Her midterms and final are extremely difficult! Her class is just a waste of time.

Professor doesn't really seem to know what she is talking about. Reads directly off slides and doesn't do much explanation of anything. There's a quiz everyday in class so make sure you go for that. STUDY THE TEXTBOOK bc a lot of hw/test questions are from there. Tests tends to be harder than classwork and homework.
She is great. The lecture is easy to understand, and she will send all the class materials to students which makes the reviw and pre-study easy.

Vindya is the best teacher ever. Yes we have mini quizzes at the beginning of every class and homework due often. But she's totally understanding if you need more time or help. She responds to emails all the time and is so caring. She also will explain things a bunch of different ways until you understand it. Take her for calc 2, you won't regret!

prof bhat is amazing. she is so organized and moves at a slow but engaging pace. she is not condescending at all and is really willing to help outside of class. I really believe she is invested in our individual success. I've never written a review before but i love vindya. obviously the content of calc 2 is difficult, but she makes it much easier!

She is very good at helping you understand. She has "class starters" (basically quizzes) which I thought I would hate but it actually helped me so much. I knew what I understood and it really helped me prepare for what the tests were going to be like.

reviews.comment: Professor Bhat is very caring, inspirational, humorous and willing to help. The lectures are clear. Highly recommend her class!

Professor Bhat is very organized, clear and very helpful. Professor Bhat gives so much work for how little you learn. She tries her best at lectures but most people zone out. Be prepared to learn a lot of the material on your own from the book. shes alright. trails off during midsentence

Vindya Bhat is mad lit. She recommended this movie about math for a bunch of us to watch, it seemed lame so no one went but the gesture was cool. Just show up to class and do your homework, you're the one dropping 60K on the degree. Her tests are hard but at the end of the day calc is the art of surfing the curve.

Professor Bhat is probably one of the best Calc 1 professors at NYU. She's really, REALLY organized. I especially liked how she structures her lectures. She uploads lecture slides in advance so we know exactly what will be covered in class, and she runs through a few examples to explain theories. Excellent professor, would definitely recommend.
Such a great professor. Weekly Quiz hw and web assign are required. 20 Attendances are recorded.  Love her so I take her statistics next semester. Clear speech. Appropriate pace.

I am in Calc 1. She gives clear explanations in class. Do your webassigns for practice. It's great and it really helps. Don't cheat on them. Her tests are hard if you don't study diligently. She is always happy to ask and her explanations are through but you have to ask her for help.
Homework was super hard and long every week; weekly quizzes that were pretty easy. Midterms are HARD. My average wo counting exams was a 95%, w them it drops to an 80%.
she's always willing to help, but her homework is so difficult and so time consuming. It's ridiculous.
Clear in explanation. If you are confused, simply ask, either in class or at some other time.

Not college level teaching. Acting for kindergarten. We have to learn dialogue from scene study but she just says good job and because she is not an actress it is a waste of time. Other teacher section much better use of student energy.

I am so angry to find out now that Mary Bitel is away this semester because she is a terrible teacher first of all, she is not a professional actress and I could take this class this semester with a real actor!!!!!! She is a waste of time. She wants every person to like her that is all she cares about.

As someone who didn't know that much about acting Shakespeare, Mary was INCREDIBLY helpful! She was such a bright and positive force in the classroom, gave great feedback, and challenged my acting skills. Most importantly, she made sure everyone was having fun at the end of the day. HIGHLY recommend taking The Bard Out Loud with her!
She is so kind, and the Bard out Loud class was really fun. Gives great feedback, and as someone who has never done theater, she made it very easy and accessible. Take her!

I really liked Mary and her Working with Groups class. The class was interesting and taught me quite a bit that I plan to apply in the future. Mary is nice, but her Working with Groups class is so freaking boring. It seems like she says the same main points every class. very kind, lots of reading, take her!! doesn't give feedback but gives good grades

she yaps all damn class its really really boring but shes a diva at times. we read a lot of books and have a group project/presentation which was easy; all tests are online and long answer, we have two big essays she's a tough grader on those; a mix between art history and like literary history; overall class is super easy A take her!!

She's amazing. Sometimes she dominates class in that it is hard to participate, and sometimes she doesn't always respect your opinion, but she is passionate about her CF class. There's a lot of art history involved which is so-so, but it is otherwise very interesting. There are readings, a presentation, essays, and a midterm/final. Easy A w/ effort

Kathy was a good teacher at times. But I have never sat through such opinionated lectures before. I left a few classes almost in tears. She has a good heart and the material is easy, but if you are actually trying to learn I would stray away.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Kathy is the BEST professor ever. SERIOUSLY, take her if you can! She is so caring + nice and her class is always so interesting. Most of her quizzes are pass-fail and you can easily get by without doing the reading, but I would recommend doing it because she loves when students participate!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Easy papers and interesting topics are covered in class, but the midterm was hard. Participation and essays are grade boosters. Final was take home, which was easier for both her and for us. Not exceptional, but still one of the best CF teachers out there.
Kathy is one of the best professors you will ever have at NYU. She is funny, intelligent, and extremely knowledgeable. She explains things in a clear way. If you don't take her you're missing out!

I LOVE HER!!! She was my first professor at NYU and she really knows what she is talking about. She is understanding, hilarious and is extremely clear with what she expects from you. Only 2 papers and 2 exams, very manageable course

Amazing professor! Very accessible outside of the classroom. Two essays and a Midterm (which was pretty difficult) and Final (Take home). I would recommend taking her if you're looking to procrastinate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The best prof ever. Super engaging and caring connects everything to modern day. Pass/fail quizzes on reading occasionally, super easy, and interesting essay topics. I highly recommend.
This class is the worst, its all art history which is dumb. Tests are way too hard with how mediocre the information you learn is. I don't write reviews, but wanted to warn my fellow men.

Kathy is a great professor. She always tries to relate the hundred year old readings to the modern day. She is very approachable and really inspiring. However, she does not like lateness and attendance/ participation really matters. It is useful to actually read the books-- it will make the papers and tests easier.
I really enjoyed class with Kathy. She made lectures interesting by including a lot of different types of sources. She likes when people participate so speak at least once every class.
She is the most understanding, kind, wonderful, and open professor. Student opinions and ideas matter to her the most. Her classes are always fun and interesting.

Amazing teacher, always open about expectations, keeps students engaged and can be really funny. She applies the readings to modern day which makes discussion more interesting and tends to get more people involved.

I absolutely adore Kathy! She's an amazing professor. The LS curriculum is pretty dull, but Kathy knows how to make history come alive. I'm going to miss office hours in Starbucks. Good luck in trying to enroll in her class; her class fills up quick!

Had her for CFI and CFII.. WISH I could take her for CFIII. She's passionate about what she teaches.  One take home exam, one midterm, two papers - SUPER easy if you just put a little bit of effort. Also she's hilarious and super easy to talk to!

Kathy is an amazing professor! I took her for CF 1 and HAD to take her for CF 2, she is just so good. She's very understanding of the problems students face and is happy to help out in any way she can. Her tests and papers are not meant to terrorise us but help us, and she is always willing to meet with us for any additional help (at Starbucks!)

Kathy - as she introduced herself on day one - is an absolute gem. I am not an art history buff in the slightest, and to be honest it doesn't really interest me, but Kathy kept me engaged day in and day out. Her lectures are fun and lively and the coursework is very manageable. If you skim the reading, you'll be fine. Can't recommend enough.

Probably the best professor you could have for CFI. Kathy manages to effectively teach you the material and get you to work without the stress. She's not specific with reading deadlines as long as you get it done. She's funny in class and relates material to modern day. Midterm was tricky but the final was take-home, easy. 2 essays. Def recommend.

She's super understanding and assigns a reasonable workload (mostly reading & group projects). Participation counts & she takes attendance out loud everyday. I wasn't interested in the books, but she always had engaging lectures. 2 essays (5-7pgs), an easy midterm, & a take home final. Overall, an amazing class. I'm taking her again next semester.
I love prof. Bishop! She's really sweet and is passionate about what she teaches. If you ask for an extension, she'll more than likely give it to you.

Great professorsuper engaging and very passionate. Not an "easy A" class however. Her midterm was quite tricky. Participation encouraged. Two big essays for the class, some readings, and a midterm and a final. Take her if you want a nice and interesting teacher but you do have to work. She takes attendance out loud at the beginning of every class.

Dr. Bishop was the best professor I have ever had. She is absolutely hilarious and engaging and taking her class was the best decision I've made so far in the LS program. She is a gem. Take any of her classes - beyond the fact that she is relatively easy, she is engaging and relatable and truly a character. I wish she were my mother.

Kathy is an amazing professor. I highly recommend her (if you can hit the "enroll" button first!) She makes you really interested in the readings and it's worth it if you come out of NYU with more knowledge than had before- your tuition money is going towards bringing you amazing professors like her at NYU.

I definitely recommend taking her! Class participation is not necessary, but appreciated. If you go to her office hours (usually at Starbucks haha) you'll be fine. She's an extremely fair grader. Midterm was a but tricky, but easy. Her lectures are also really relevant to the modern world. Best teacher this sem!

I'm definitely taking Kathy again for Cultural foundations II. She's a great professor; she's so laid back and she really tries to make the class relatable and interesting for students. Definitely take her.
professor bishop has been my favorite professor since arriving at NYU.  I was excited to attend her class and she is the most amazing teacher.  TAKE HER FOR CULTURAL FOUNDATIONS!!

Kathy is the EPITOME of what a professor at a prestigious university should be. She lectures in a way that gets your attention, her assignments are SIMPLE and ALWAYS CLEAR, she's easy on grading if you actually try - and you end up getting the grade you TRULY deserve. Take her if you can!

Voted top professors in nation by Princeton Review. She isn't the BEST teacher I've ever had, but she's pretty good. VERY understanding. Essays are easy peasy. Midterm was easy - I didn't read anything and I got an A. As long as you pay attention (which isn't hard, she's hilarious) you'll for sure get an A. TAKE HER.
I love Kathy! She loves the subject she teaches and does a great job of making you like it too. She's Very straightforward so if you pay attention in class you'll do fine.

By far my favorite teacher at NYU. She's a really sweet person, very clear when it comes to papers & exams, and always open to students' suggestions. Unlike a lot of other professors, she manages to make the assigned readings relevant to her students. That's why her class is so much fun. If I could, I would take her class again for CF III.

Easy grader, great teacher, and a really nice woman in general. She's a bit of a feminist, but she gives a refreshing perspective on history. Kind of standoffish at first but very approachable as the weeks go by. I would take her again in a heartbeat if I could. One of my favorite teachers that I've ever had. You will not regret taking her class.
Very good professor. Nice, fair, and helpful.
Not the most brightest professor, but the class was incredibly easy albeit boring. Class discussions proved to be off topic and pointless.

She was absolutely fantastic! One of the most enthusiastic teachers I've had in my freshman year & I had her for both semesters (CFI & CFII). Take her! You will learn and become interested in art and culture even if you are not.

Very nice with a good sense of humor. Makes course material relevent to students and the modern world.Reading isn't too heavy--only makes you read parts of most of the books. 2 papers, 2 exams (including miderm and final), 2 quizzes (VERY simple). Likes discussion and student feedback. Seems standoffish at first, but actually very approachable.

Very nice with a good sense of humor. Makes course material relevent to students and the modern world. The reading isn't too heavy--she only makes you read parts of most of the books. 2 papers, 2 exams (including miderm and final), 2 quizzes (VERY simple). Likes discussion and student feedback. Standoffish at first, but actually very approachable.

She is just a phenomenal professor who is charismatic about what she teaches and truly engages her students. I have come to adore her open minded teaching style and she has always helped her students. She is a MUST. Love Professor Bishop! Work hard and you will receive a grade that accurately reflects your effort. =)

Bishop is like the female version of Woody Allen. She's so cool and knows how to engage a class. If you take her, its an easy A and you learn so much. She's always willing to help and her class isn't a lot of work (2 quiz, 2 essays, 2 tests). She's really approachable and loves when people participate. Take her and you'll love her!

Professor Bishop is amazing. She is genuinely interested in all of her students, structures all of her lessons/readings around what is interesting and relevant to student as much as possible. Always willing to help students outside of class. Not a fan of cultural foundations, but a big fan of Bishop's class, and Bishop herself. Two papers/Two exams

Kathy is awesome. Puts ancient things in modern terms. Easy to understand. A stickler for grammar in papers, but if you have a solid idea then you'll get a good grade. Light workload and decent grade. She might be a little scary at first but once you get to know her she's fun! Starts great class discussions. I learned a lot from her.
Easy professor. Explains what you need to know in class for simple midterm and final. two essays (5-7 pages easy topics). Great in all ways.

One of the best at NYU. Very compassionate, kind, and fair. She is very knowledgeable about the subject matter, and knows how to convey that knowledge to her students. If you have the opportunity - take one of her classes.
It's all been said. Take her. Seriously.
Great professor :) very personable. Easy class!

By far one of my favorite professors at NYU!!! I actually wanted to come to her class! You dont really have to read the text because she goes over them in class. She makes everything seem easy! I only wish I was able to have her for CFII

Like everyone always says, super great teacher. The material and exams arent so easy, but she makes everything so clear and extremley understanding. Go for it. VERY VERY Good grader, as long as you do decent work

Professor Bishop is AWESOME. She engages students in discussion, provides helpful comments on essays, and really tries to help you understand. She's an honest grader. She is really passionate about the subject she teaches, which in turn makes you really interested in it too! Who would have known I've come to like Roman art so much...

by far the best professor i've had at NYU! so nice and classes are fun :) workload is okay, and you would actually look forward to going to class! she gives lots of hints about whats on the midterm and final.

The best teacher I've had so far- she's AMAZING. She's passionate about the subject and wants you to be too.  SO SO understanding. For the paper, you can make up your own topic - i made one 2 days before the deadline and she gave me an extension. Easy A but you will actually learn.  Even a group project for EC is optional.I'm sad to be leaving =(
The best teacher I've had so far- she's AMAZING.

Cultural Foundations I and II professor.  By far the best cult. professor in the department. I'm not going to waste your time with a description, they've already been written.  I actually signed up for 2 semesters (cult. 1+2) with her!  Highly recommend her.
she's great and you become so interested in whatever she is teaching. And she's funny
Very helpful, great lecturer, gives clear essays, assuming you study, midterms and finals will be reasonably easy.  Keen wit, will keep you entertained, great professor.
Bishop is a great teacher, she cares about her students and the subject matter and always shoots down the smartasses.  The class is mad easy too, I'd definetly recommend her

Talk about an amazing teacher. Amazingly helpful and understanding. Fair to easy grader. She makes the topics so easy that you're really stupid if you don't understand. She tries to make class relate to the real world. By far my favorite teacher in NYU, we really need more like her!!!
Lecture style, moreso than other GSP classes.  Workload is somewhat manageable...Really nice though.  Highly recommend her!

She is one of my favorite professors, and a mentor of mine.  Very helpful, cares about her students, and tries to make class interesting.  Not to hard of a grader, and is very fair when it comes to most things.  She is a one-of-a-kind.  TAKE HER CLASS.

easy grader, easy class. she lectures, mostly but does try to get the students to talk once in a while. shes very considerate and id say lenient. seems not to care for grades much, just wants her students to learn

Dr. Bishop was amazing. She used real life examples to explain what was going on with the material she covered. She understands that her class is not the only one we take and does not assign unreasonable amounts of reading. She is extremely intersting and knowledgeable. I would reccomend this class to anyone.
I lovee this teacher.  She makes the stuff soo interesting.  And she teaches!!  =)  Awesome awesome awesome.  i really hope I get her again.  She's my favorite
No Comments

i took her my 1st semester at nyu a few years ago, and she remains one of my favorite prof's of all time. she's amazing, smart, and fun. i had 104 average in her class b/c she makes you really want to know the material

She is amazing. She will make everyone in the class interested in the readings by drawing on subjects that everyone can relate to. you can have amazing conversations without even having read the material. she is awesome, probably my best gsp class. She makes you love reading, and love class.
I am SO upset I couldn't get her for CulFou II. INCREDIBLE teacher. Makes what seems like really boring material fun and fresh. Lucky, lucky you if you have her.

Bishop is great.  Class is fun and laid back.  She tells some good stories, always relates things to the present with the occasional Jessica Simpson or George Bush anecdote.  SHe is quite liberal, so if thats not your bag, watch out.  I plan on taking her again if possible.

Really loved class with her. She's clear, entertaining and helps you to know your stuff. Her tests were hard but her grading wasn't overly harsh. Cultural has been fun with her because we can talk about our opinions on topics and learn.
i wish i could take bishop's class again. she took our whole class to starbucks the other day. shes one of the nicest teachers ive ever had

Kathy is the best teachers, and best friends I have ever had. There are no words to describe how wonderful of a person she is.  Her class is great too; she makes everything really enjoyable.  Never a boring moment with her!  Kathy's class is a must take!!

This is the best class you'll take. Kathy's approach makes great books easy to appreciate and understand.  The more you put into this class by talking to her and keeping up with the readings, the more you'll love it.

she is a very engaging and knowledgeable woman... The class is pretty standard being that is one of the requirements, however, she made it more enjoyable and interesting. The more involved you are the more you can get out of the class and out of her.

She is one of the best teachers ever. The work load is a little bit hard, but not unmanageable. She is extremely reasonable in her expectations. One of the most understanding teachers I have ever encountered. By far, the best teacher I've ever had.
bro, safe urself. like actually save ur life. don't. jus don't
The course itself isn't that bad but the professor itself isn't the best.very inconsiderate at times if you are a minute late and doesn't take any excuses.

If you are struggling in this class I would personally not recommend going to her office hours for improvement. Since if you go to her office hours she would just insult you on how bad you did and say you should not majoring in econ. I would just personally recommend to go the Ta's office hours for help. Other than that she is fine.

By far the best class I've taken at NYU. If you're an Econ major leaning towards finance, this class is for you. I've had interview questions often asked about material that's taught in this class. Professor is strict for sure but everything will go smoothly if you follow her guidelines. (attend lecture she often will tell you whats on the exam!)
Tests can be confusing, not that hard though. No quizzes or anything else. Just tests. Pretty easy if you actually study to be honest.

Professor is extremely rude for little to no reason and despite what people say "you get what you give", it is practically impossible to get anything from this professor. Went for feedback on a test and she was extremely rude with no constructive criticism despite actively wanting to learn and improve.

She is definitely strict, but her rules are very clear: don't be late and don't go on your phone. As long as you follow those relatively simple requests, you'll be fine. Don't let all these ratings scare you. Her class is not as difficult as everyone says just read the textbook and study hard. There is a good curve at the end of the course.

Strict, but will be easier towards the end of the semester. Lectures are not needed if you just read the textbook, but will be helpful for graph drawing. Attend recitations. For studying, practice recitation problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is good and explains concepts clearly. If you attend class, take notes, and work hard, you will do well on the exams, since she literally tells you what will be tested. She can be a bit harsh at times, but the class itself is interesting and well-structured. As long as you put in the effort, you'll be fine. The material is manageable.

she's a good professor and funny, the class is just hard and she's pretty strict about certain things like using your phone or coming in late (sometimes she's rude to people who ask questions). Go to class, take good notes, go to TA bill, and you will be good. Her practice questions and exams are really helpful and so are examples given in class.

She does come off very strict and mean, but honestly, I enjoyed her lectures. They were interesting and she gave many examples that I was able to relate to. She did brutally scold me during a one-on-one meeting for "memorizing" my way through the class, and I was very sad :( but afterwards I changed my study methods and improved a lot on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The TA's helped me get through this class. Drop you're ego at the door. Do the textbook reading, GO TO CLASS, go to recitation and TA office hours. Generous Curve. It isn't all that bad but if you have another option take that one instead!!

Bhiladwalla is a funny and good professor if you attend lecture and recitation. She will publicly berate you if you're late but her class is easier than the other section. Saying that she's bad means you didn't go to lecture where she tells you everything on the test and explains the material in depth multiple times. You get what you give.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: MB is effective and good at teaching. She is very harsh and will belittle and publicly shame students that come in late to lecture, are talking, or on their phone. With that being said, if you can manage to come on time and stay off your phone, she is totally worth it. Her curves were fair, study guides helpful, and the homework was easy.

Eveyrone that is giving her a 1 is tweaking. The class isn't super easy but as long as your ego isn't super fragile and your fine showing up to class on time and not going on your phone I would take this class. As long as you show up and do the readings you will do well and the curve was like 7% this year, so not that hard to get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I recommend going to EVERY recitation.. I also ended up getting tutored for the final, which helped a lot. The material is not hard; the wording on the tests is just very confusing (it's all multiple choice). Sometimes I felt like the questions were set up to purposely trick u. But if you fully know the material, you will be okay. don't fall behind

If you decide to take her, gg. I was once in ur position, i read the reviews and took the gamble. I paid the price, do not take the gamble, avoid this infinitely discouraging professor. The best part of this class was that I did not have to attend. other than that, good luck.

she's condescending and her lectures are just slides however she does teach pretty well so it's helpful to actually attend the lectures. Her tests are all mcq although the wording is often weird and confusing. Her TAs are good too. the 2 midterms and final make up 88% of your grade.

She posts some slides, doesn't post others, you don't know when you have to come to class. Her practice tests are not like the actual ones. She goes very fast, blows through 60 slides in 1 SITTING. I must say, she does give you chapters and stuff of that to know, but she always does some weird twist on tests.

Genuinely the worst professor I've ever had at NYU thus far. Her tone in delivering class content and answering questions is incredibly condescending- she will make it a point to humiliate you instead of helping you understand what you're wondering. I personally stopped showing up to lectures mid-semester.

Horrible. HORRIBLE. She does not know how to spell, her questions on the test are unclear. If you go to her for feedback she will just yell at you. DO NOT TAKE!!!!! The other reviews are real. She is horrible.

Run!!! Pretty much what everyone said tbh. If you need it for your major, take it next semester or change major like i did (she could be helpful, but if you're not doing well, she'll tell you econ is not for you and to change your major)....If she's your only option, all I can say is pray! If you don't have a religion, pick one and start praying.

All the RMP reviews for this class sum it up really well. The class isn't easy by any means but Prof. Bhiladwalla is fair. She'll explain what's on the exam and leaves lecture slides up when they discuss tricky concepts. Cannot emphasize enough how important it is to go to lectures and actually pay attention! That'll be your best test prep.

Her lectures are meandering and do a poor job of explaining fairly simple concepts. Tests are extremely difficult and have little resemblance to practice material and in-class content. Avoid taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I thought my life was over but I went to her office hours and she helped pass so thank her for that
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Bhiladwalla is fine. Since I took econ in high school I found this class easy as it was a review for me, but if I had no prior knowledge of economics I would have been very lost. She is funny but not always good at completly explaining the concepts. If you miss one lecture she will not go over it again, so attendance is pretty important.

She's the reason I'm pass failing and retaking the course later. She's good at teaching but she can ask about things she hasn't gone over in the exams. Her midterms are mcq's but are very difficult nonetheless. The class is interesting but it will tank your gpa if you're not blessed with micro skills by the gods. DON'T TAKE HER!!! You'll thank me.

She's a good teacher, not a great person. She teaches the material well for sure if you go to class regularly but she's hella mean if u come to class late/use ur phone its kinda OD. Exams are hard for sure but if you go to class often she tells you a lot of whats on the exam. Homework is light just mcq's.

I really enjoyed her Intro to Micro class. She is very strict and will call you out if you come to class late, but I thought she did a good job of teaching during her lectures. The homework she assigns and the practice exams were also really helpful. She's also easy to access in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is super strict with her policies and will come up to you and yell in your face in front of 200 people if you have your phone out in class. Midterms and Final take up 90% of your grade so it's super test heavy. I dropped it for a less intense class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: she can come off as mean, but she is an amazing lecturer. exams can be hard/graded strictly but should be find if you do all you reading, review lectures, and do practice problems provided. she gets so much hate since she bell curves pretty strictly, but you definitely learn a lot in this class.

Her MC exams are pretty bad she is a harsh grader, but she does tell you what is on the tests if you show up to class, and take notes regularly. She is a little strict about phones (she kicked a kid out for it), and showing up to class on time. But overall, not too bad.

all the comments are true, she will be willing at people and be kinda rude. but if you're able to get over that, class content is actually pretty interested/relevant. if you pull up to class and pay attention exams are fine (she tells in advance what sort of stuff will be in the exam). if you're interested in finance then take it, but will be work
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a good professor even she doesn"t like use computer. For money and banking, writing on board is a better way to relate each part to learn.

Bhiladwalla is the best professor I've had so far. Money and Banking is a hard class, but she knows the material and gives a good lecture. If you listen carefully to her lecture and take good notes, you will get an A in the exam (the curve is generous for the final)

Lectures are thorough and you can tell she cares a lot about her students and their success. Exams are very straight forward and mirror practice exams, sometimes even having the same exact problems. If you attend lecture, pay attention, and study for exams, you will get an A (those who are complaining probably dont go to class or study)
she continuously yells at kids during exams loud af disturbing the rest of the class that's in the lecture room trying to focus. so disturbing. very angry 24/7.

This professor destroyed my phone and my career I had to study 3 classes amount for this one class and it did AoE damage to my other grades plz avoid this professor at all costs. I would unalive myself before taking another one of these classes BEWARE
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Exams are confusing compared to other material-- prof gives nit picky questions that aren't explicitly gone over in material. Homework isn't bad, just do all the practice problems and read the textbook because her lectures are not that easy to understand.

She can be very rude at times and will yell at you in front of the class if you come late. Her notes are also very messy and hard to follow. However, the class itself is quite easy and the exams are extremely straightforward as long as you studied. Put in the work and you'll get a good grade.

Prof comes off as strict, but the class isn't too bad. All the major exams are mcq, and the curve is pretty generous. The textbook helped a lot because her lectures are a bit confusing. As long as you read the text book the class shouldn't be too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her teaching is awful and her tests are very difficult
She makes the tests extremely difficult, and is extremely strict. Her feedback on improvement was not helpful!!

Can actually learn how things work if you stay humble and obedient. Curves it at the end so it's not 93%+ to get A. However the final grading is vague, homework is graded on average and exams is calculation-heavier than other profs. Avoid if you are below-average clever or sluggish about work.
Might seems strict, overall good professor. A little asccent, but clear enough to understand. Not too hard exam. do curve the grade. one of the best Econ-UA 2xx courses alongside with Urban.
Tough class and she is very strict with phones and tardiness but you will learn a lot. Probably one of the most useful 200 level econ courses to take. Tells you what will be on the exam beforehand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Out of every lecture in the class I could pick out about 3 examples of hers that made sense, every time she introduced a topic the textbook was clearer and easier to understand. Take a better lecturer and save yourself the trouble.
Hard to understand and follow, NYU please hire better professors especially for intro classes.

I started this semester thinking she was a good teacher, but I realized the opposite. She overcomplicates everything, making it hard to take notes, and struggles to explain clearly. Most peers agree. Her final exam highlighted her teaching failures, and her classes, though called "essential," are useless. Save yourself a headache.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's super strict and can't teach clearly. I got 5 in AP microecon but can't understand what she's talking about. Her slides are so confusing, long, and full of long sentences. 88% GPA for three tests and the curve is so light, about equal to zero. Donno why she got 4.4 on rmp when I was selecting courses. F rmp you deceived me
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: if you make mistakes on exams, she condescends to you and doesn't help you get better, just says "you lost this part". in terms of supporting her students, she doesn't answer any questions that are not hyper specific on the basis of "I'm not reteaching the lecture"
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the rumors are true about her yelling at students for being late and going on their phones during class, but she is just an extremely dedicated professor who wants students to respect her time. questions on exams are no surprise, but she does expect really specific answers which is a pain. def only take if u need to
Lectures and notes are very confusing. Exams are more complicated than what she teaches and assigns. Also yells at you for being late and having phone out.

Challenging course, but worth it. Lectures are crucial - stay engaged and use resources like unstuck AI to supplement your learning. The professor is strict but knowledgeable. If you're committed, you'll get a lot out of this class.
I never wear check the traffic light when walking to this professor's lectures because I want to get run over before I arrive.

Does not depend on the textbook, and lectures herself using a blackboard. You will be fine if you go to all of her lectures and listen carefully. She tells what she will ask on the exams and what answers she is looking for. She may be harsh on some students time to time but overall she is a nice person.
She's amazing but the course is difficult. Lectures are important even though there's no attendance. Get ready to study extra hard for this course. But at the end it's worth it.
simply mean about everything. insult students who are late

you have to study a lot for a good grade in this class but not that hard if you do -- probably the most useful course in the entire econ major sequence. prof always tells you what questions are going to be on the exam and is super helpful if you are committed to the class. lectures are always super helpful, TA's are all incredible too!!
Would not recommend

The professor, during lecture, often talks about what would appear on the exam. The exam questions would also appear word to word from her description. Very humorous during lecture and extremely insightful. Won't hesitate to chose her as her only requirement is no phones for 75 minutes, which shouldn't be difficult to follow.

def a bit tightly wound, but she is very clear about her expectations and grading criteria.
