I love prof diamond, so caring and kind. Very organized syllabus and a decent amount of homework. The reading may get a little bit heavy if you're a freshman, but I managed to get through. Three 5 pages essays based on what you learned and read; easy if you read and listen to the lecture.

It's evidenteven in a remote classthat Professor Diamond is incredibly knowledgeable and cares about what he's teaching. I love how his class is set up on NYU classes and he gives very clear instructions for assignments. There's a decent amount of reading, but it's not bad if you manage your time well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Prof. Diamond is a very nice Professor. He is knowledgeable and always tries to connect the texts with the modern world. Class discussions are fun and insightful. Very caring and understanding. 5 papers per semester, he always gives detailed feedback on your work. Fast and fair grader

Good guy, super intelligent but sometimes hard to follow due to monotone. He's awesome but it is a LOT OF WORK that's expected, and he definitely knows who has and hasn't done the readings. No final exam though, but very few grades to bring it up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is great. Facilitates students to higher levels of discussion and drives you to participate for a good effort grade. Know your stuff.

This class is more work than it should be. More than anything Diamond just wants people to talk. I definitely didn't read/understand anything but he kept giving me B+s. His lectures are super boring and he assigns A LOT of papers (5 total). Just talk and sparknotes the books.

Not recommended. Classes are extremely boring and its easy to lose focus. He just goes on and on about whatever the subject is for the day, writes nothing on the board, and just finds random excerpts from the book. You must read the rather long readings and raise your hand all the time to like the class in any way. 4 papers, not the easiest grader

He's very boring. The papers are incredibly easy, though the guidelines for his "Athenian Assembly Game" are very vague and it's hard to get a good grade. You might as well not try for a participation grade because everyone gets a B.

Diamond is a kind man who is passionate about teaching, but his style is dry and yawn-worthy. His assignments are straightforward, but he grades with bias because he knows so much that any opinion that strays is wrong in his mind. Don't try to sound like you know what you're talking about, even if you do, because he will always protest question.

I agree with most people on here- PDids is a sweetheart.  He is very kind and understanding about absences and very patient in general.  I suppose his class is a bit drab if youre not interested in the subject, but if you try to participate and do the reading its really interesting and goes by quick.  I would highly reccommend his class to anyone!

Participate from the first day of class and participate every day. Go to his office hours about papers. Using wikipedia was more useful than reading the books. Class can get a bit boring but overall great course. He is passionate about what he teaches.
Took two classes with him, great guy.  Extremely interesting and tells you from day one what to expect.  Participate, write a few papers, and enjoy!

Just signed up for his Social Foundations for the 3rd semester. Great professor and most intelligent man! He is full of great ideas - i have learned so much in his class. He relates everything to current day events. His voice is really soothing so sometimes you feel the need to fall asleep but just wake up and enjoy his insight! 100% recommend!

Pretty chill professor- not extremely interesting nor boring. Still, there are the boring days. Fair grader. The game was interesting and competitive- good way to boost up grades... I advise him only because if you want to be safe and not venture out to try new teachers, Diamond is good.

AWESOME TEACHER!!!!! not super hard but not super easy.....we play this game where we are all members of the national assembly during the french revolution and it i sooooo amazing....def take this class

He's a really nice guy, really interactive but you have to love participating if you want to enjoy the class. He is a pretty fair grader and expects you to do the reading. But he is really a smart man and he made Plato understandable. Take him!

He is an awesome teacher. We played this awesome game which has you become an Athenian in the Assembly of Athen. It was really cool. He is also really interesting and you don't need to do too much beyond listening in class to maintain a B
He's a pretty fair grader. There are 2 required papers and 2 during a pointless game he makes us play. Besides the game, just plain, boring lecture. You get a B if you don't want to participate.
Professor Diamond is pretty boring but if you truly listen to what he has to say it's really very interesting.  He's really brilliant and helpful, so just take a lot of notes and read the material.

Diamond is SO SMART. He really knows what he is teaching and is he enthusiastic about the material. While not always the most engaging, he loves to hear students' views and opinion. Take his nation building class if you have any opinion on the US' war in Iraq whatsoever!

So boring...follows the same structure every day, class is open discussion but extremely dull if you aren't passionate about Nation Building.  Don't take this class without lots of background knowledge about global politics or you will be out of the loop.  Voice is like Tim Gunn--it will put you to sleep.
This man is very nice, but so dull. It's a pretty easy B if you don't really try. Nice guy, monotonous voice.

So boring.  You never have to participate if you don't want to, and you'll still get a B in participation.  Go to class, take some notes.  Midterms and Finals are kind of impossible to study for but also not that difficult.  Really helpful when it comes to papers.  Email it to him and he'll edit.  Boring boring boring but an easy class.

This guy is smart. By taking his class, I just felt a lot smarter sitting in that chair and listening to him. Only important caution is that his voice can occasionally put you to bed. But other than that, the class was insightful.
No Comments
Great class, he's smart and helpful, and very interactive, but doesn't pick on you if you don't wanna talk.  Very clear on what he wants, but still flexible.
Good professor and excellent lectures. Always made sure to explain things well and ensure student understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is hard as it tackles a lot of content and new concepts, but the professor makes an effort to be accessible out of class and explain as good as he can. THe class is hard in concept and exercises canbe tricky, but he really does his best to help.

The course requires a heavy amount of content, so it can sometimes feel rushed, but he is accessible outside of class.
He cares about his students and their understanding. He managed to move my final exam date and was okay when I declined. TLDR, he is a good professor teaching a hard class.

Unless you are really smart or want to spend tons of time on this course, run :(
The first half was easy but second half is really confusing and requires lots of time to understand.
Run!!!!
Get ready to learn by yourself
Bad professor. After midterm2, 10%-20% student withdraw from his class
Enjoy taking this course with professor Erik. He is very nice and accessible. He would be patient and provides you a lot of examples if you don't understand the concept

I took him in the summer during covid for MFE and basically never came to class, watching the recorded lecture when I am confused on homework. He did not in fact make my GPA Dies, but I can't say whether that will happen to you in the present day.

I heard from my friend that he was very strict in grading and that he was terrible at teaching last semester(fall 2023) so I came to this class without high expectation. I have to say that Professor Dies has changed a lot! The exam was not hard and he assigned sample exam in which some of the questions appeared on the final!

This professor was assigned to this course at the very last minute before the start of this semester. So it seems like he does not know what he is teaching. You need to depend on reading the textbook and self-studying in order to pass the exam because his lectures are basically picking some random contents from the book and read it for class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very considerate, generous and caring guy. He's very knowledgeable about the content. Though the course is extremely difficult and abstract as a stats class, and the exams are very tough, he gives very very generous curve!!! Just go to class, read the book, do your homework. You are certainly going to make an A in this class.
Dies is a brilliant professor. Math is hard and Prof Dies explains the concepts and also stimulates invigorating conversations and Rick illustrative examples. Great prof if you are good at math.

Good professor overall but I find it so hard to keep track on courses, everything is perfect except he's extremely monotoned and lectures are rlly boring, its hard to focus on material 100% of the time, and no sample exam at all. Slow grading. but remember everything else is good, I just wanna talk bout what I'm struggling with.

Summer 2021. Pretty standard as a math professor, textbook material is converted and summarized into readily understandable handwritten pdf notes, and the exam is not difficult at all, given very sufficient time. There's a lot of homework tho.

Spr 2020. Very robotic and basically reads the textbook word by word. That being said, he is helpful and friendly if you ask in or outside of class for him to explain a concept. Quiz every class, forces you to stay on track. Exams were moderate-easy for someone with good maths skills. Occasionally cracks a joke, pretty funny guy.
He is somewhat robotic but is very knowledgable on the material.

He has a talent for being able to explain and teach concepts well, not everyone can do that. I don't how how true it is but I get the feeling that he actually cares about students succeeding, not just doing his job teaching and moving on with his life.

Dies is a very solid teacher. He's difficult, but it seems appropriate given the class. Very good lecturer who can explain confusing topics with precision and care. Caring. The daily quizzes are good to keep you on track and can boost your grade. Show up to class, read the book if you don't (it's a good book), and you're in good shape. Recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is the best professor ever. Work hard and you will get an A. If you are struggling he will do his best to give you a respectable grade. He genuinely wants to see everyone move on to the next course. He is the best person I ever met
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Go to class, but his lectures aren't great if you aren't the best at calc or visualizing math. He mostly just goes through examples from the book. I needed a lot of extra help understanding concepts. I struggled in his class but he is very kind. not an L if you get him but there are probably better options.

He's a good lecturer, clear and concise and willing to help with problems. He tries his best to make you understand why things work the way they do. Exam was easier than the midterm, and he curves everyone below a certain grade. Solid teacher, would take again for future math classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Pretty fair tests although I've heard he's harder than other professors for Discrete. Was rough for an 8am but make the effort to go to classes and he'll reward you (gave a random pop quiz that was to write your favorite number down). Would take again! Very clear and great clear voice
Good lecture, but he makes the homework harder than other instructor, as far as I know other two sections doesn't have that much homework, nor hard exam.
took it over the summer and he had no office hours. Unclear grading criteria but nbd. Would take again if he has office hours.
Very interesting and clear teacher.  Helped me break down my assignments into simple logical progressions.  Respects his students.
He is a great teacher. His lectures are very clear cut and really knows his material and how to explain it. . Always there to help. Tests are pretty standard  GREAT TEACHER! I RECOMMEND
I took it over the summer and he had no office hours.
Uses real examples in homework. Requires programming not in course description (in syllabus, though).
Fair, not great. Teach from the book, but give inspiring homework. Good voice.
His lectures are very helpful. He is a very great professor. He helped me towards an a in the class.
Dies is an overall great professor. He has a great sense of humor.
Helpful.

Erik is hands down the best lecturer you can possibly have for a Math class. He begins each class with an organized, concise review of the previous class. He is very approachable if you're missing a concept and he gives very strong hints as to what he'll put on the exam. He makes hard Math subjects bearable.

Erik is a fantastic communicator who likes to do mini review sessions of prior material at the start of each class. This is helpful come exam time as well as for quiz preparation. His midterm was very easy as was his final exam. Do all the HWs and ace one of the two exams and you'll receive an A.

Great lecturer, took him for Calculus 2.  He really made the topics we covered clear.  Always open to questions from students and speaks CLEAR English (Which is definitely important for a math class)  Take him if you can
